title: Customer Support with Advancement Opportunities
description:
We are looking for a highly communicative, organized, and proactive Customer Support Representative to join our growing team.



In this role, you will become one of the primary points of contact for our clients, cleaning professionals, and prospective customers. Every conversation is an opportunity to create a 5-star experience.



You'll answer questions, solve problems, coordinate schedules, support our cleaning teams, and ensure every customer feels taken care of. When an issue cannot be resolved independently, you'll know when and how to escalate it quickly.



If you enjoy helping people, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and stay calm under pressure, we'd love to meet you.



Responsibilities

Deliver exceptional customer service through phone, text,
, and chat

Answer questions from current clients and provide timely solutions

Support our cleaning professionals with scheduling, questions, and day-to-day operational needs

Respond to new customer inquiries and qualify leads

Schedule sales appointments for our Booking Specialist team

Resolve customer concerns while maintaining a positive, professional experience

Escalate complex issues to the appropriate department when necessary

Coordinate appointment changes, cancellations, and schedule adjustments

Accurately document conversations and update customer records

Collaborate with teammates to ensure every client receives consistent, high-quality service

Identify recurring issues and communicate opportunities for process improvement



Requirements

Excellent written and spoken English

Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills

Strong problem-solving abilities and sound judgment

Ability to remain calm and professional during difficult conversations

Outstanding organizational and multitasking skills

Comfortable learning new software and technology quickly

High attention to detail

Ability to work independently while communicating effectively with the team

Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection

Previous customer service, call center, hospitality, or administrative experience is preferred but not required



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys serving others.



The ideal candidate is positive, dependable, organized, and takes ownership of problems until they're solved. They communicate with empathy, think critically, and aren't afraid to make decisions. They enjoy working as part of a team and are always looking for ways to improve the customer experience.



If you're someone who loves helping people, takes pride in excellent communication, and wants to grow with a company that values service and accountability, we'd love to hear from you.

title: **NOW HIRING: LONG-FORM YOUTUBE EDITOR (SERIOUS APPLICANTS ONLY)**
description:
**NOW HIRING: LONG-FORM YOUTUBE EDITOR (SERIOUS APPLICANTS ONLY)**



We run fast-growing YouTube gaming channels built around I AM CAT VR: chaotic, funny VR gameplay where you play as a cat. Footage is already stacked up and ready to edit, and filling this spot is our top priority right now. The right editor could be getting paid within days.



This isn't a one-off gig. It's a stable, long-term role on a team that's growing fast. You get steady work every week, on-time pay and clear communication you can rely on. We want someone who commits and grows with us, not someone juggling 10 clients who disappears in a month.



**The Role**

- Edit long-form YouTube videos (10–20+ minutes). No shorts.

- Match our established editing style closely on every video

- Deliver within 24 hours of receiving footage



**Pay**

- **$40 per finished video** to start, with room to grow as we build trust

- Near full-time volume available: the more quality videos you can handle, the more you earn

- Paid on time via PayPal, Wise, or your preferred method



**Must-Haves**

- Proven CapCut skills (non-negotiable; show us past work)

- Consistent 24-hour turnaround

- Ability to study a reference video and copy its pacing, cuts, captions, sound effects and energy

- Sharp attention to detail on every video

- Fast, reliable communication: ask questions and never go silent

- Stable internet and a computer that handles long-form editing smoothly



**Bonus:** experience editing gaming, VR or comedy content, and a feel for comedic timing (knowing when to cut, zoom or drop a sound effect to land the joke).



**How to Apply**

Send a message that includes:

1. The word **"MEOW"** at the very start (no MEOW = deleted unread)

2. Completed 3-5 minutes of footage from our TRIAL EDIT (Mandatory - Unpaid)

3. Your CapCut experience and how long you've been editing

4. Confirmation that you can consistently hit 24-hour turnarounds

5. How many videos per week you can realistically handle



**Paid Trial**

Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial. You'll get raw footage plus a fully edited reference video, and you'll edit a 3–5 minute segment to match the reference as closely as you can.

Raw footage & Assets: 
/drive/folders/1ybvvgN72PlO8QGNhFqx4cgiPN7X2XIIh?usp=sharing

We judge the trial on how closely you match the style and how fast you turn it around. Pass, and you move straight into paid, ongoing work, immediately.



**There's ONE spot, and we're hiring the first person who's clearly the right fit.** We're growing fast, and whoever joins now grows with us. Chances like this don't come around often. Apply today.

title: Director, Global Alliances – Accenture
Junior Document & Workflow Administrator | Training Provided
description:
Build your career in document and operations support with ASISA Remote.



We are looking for a Junior Document & Workflow Administrator to keep documents and task records organised for Australian broker and lending businesses. Candidates with 1-2 years of relevant administration, document-handling or operations experience are encouraged to apply. Organised, detail-oriented fresh graduates are also welcome. Lending experience is not required; training will be provided.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Prepare and send document requests and reminders using approved templates and authorised channels.

- Receive, name, index and file documents in the correct location.

- Flag unreadable, expired or incorrectly matched documents for review.

- Update task queues with accurate status, ownership and next actions.

- Track outstanding items and follow up according to the agreed process.

- Prepare clear handovers showing completed and outstanding tasks.

- Check your work and handle confidential information carefully.



This role focuses on document organisation and workflow administration. Questions about lending assessments or loan outcomes are referred to the appropriate team member.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Strong organisation and attention to detail.

- Clear, professional written English.

- Reliable follow-through on outstanding tasks.

- Basic computer skills and confidence organising digital files.

- Willingness to learn new systems, follow procedures and receive feedback.

- A responsible approach to confidential information.



Relevant work, internship and school-project examples are welcome.



ABOUT ASISA REMOTE

Two cultures. One team. Shared success.

ASISA Remote brings together Australian business experience and Filipino operational expertise to build teams supporting Australian businesses. Our leaders take a hands-on approach to supporting our people and developing their skills.



WHY JOIN US?

- Training in Australian lending document types, procedures and approved systems.

- Guided practice, feedback and support as you build your skills.

- A team that values clear communication, accountability and respect.

- Opportunities for greater responsibility as you demonstrate competence, with potential future team lead opportunities as the team grows.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with your CV, a short introduction, an example of how you organised files or followed through on a task, your expected monthly salary in PHP and earliest available start date. School and internship examples are welcome.

Application subject: ASISA - Document & Workflow Administrator

title: Junior Credit Support Officer - Australian Home Loans | Training Provided
description:
Build your career in Australian lending support with ASISA Remote.



We are looking for a Junior Credit Support Officer to help prepare and track Australian home-loan files. Candidates with 1-2 years of relevant administration, banking, finance or processing experience are encouraged to apply. Fresh graduates with strong attention to detail are also welcome. Previous mortgage experience is helpful but not required; training will be provided.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Organise supporting documents and check readability, expiry and completeness.

- Enter factual information into approved systems using cleared instructions.

- Help prepare routine forms, checklists and application packs.

- Compare entries against source documents and flag missing or inconsistent information.

- Track outstanding documents, lender requests, valuations and settlement-related tasks as allocated.

- Keep file status, next actions and task owners up to date.

- Check your work and prepare clear handovers for credit analysts and brokers.



You will receive supervision and feedback on new tasks. Credit decisions, loan recommendations and submission approvals remain with authorised team members and brokers.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Strong attention to detail and accurate data entry.

- Clear written English for professional updates and questions.

- Good organisation and reliable follow-through.

- Basic computer and spreadsheet skills.

- Willingness to learn, follow procedures and ask questions.

- Care when handling confidential information.



Relevant work, internship and school-project examples are welcome.



ABOUT ASISA REMOTE

Two cultures. One team. Shared success.

ASISA Remote brings together Australian business experience and Filipino operational expertise to build teams supporting Australian businesses. Our leaders take a hands-on approach to supporting our people and developing their skills.



WHY JOIN US?

- Training in Australian mortgage terminology, lender requirements and approved systems.

- Guided practice, feedback and support as you build your skills.

- A team that values clear communication, accountability and respect.

- Opportunities for greater responsibility as you demonstrate competence, with potential future team lead opportunities as the team grows.

title: Junior Credit Analyst - Australian Home Loans | Training Provided
description:
Build your career in Australian lending with ASISA Remote.



We are looking for a Junior Credit Analyst to support home-loan file review and application preparation. Candidates with 1-2 years of relevant finance, accounting, banking or lending experience are encouraged to apply. Fresh graduates with strong numerical and analytical skills are also welcome for our trainee pathway. Previous Australian mortgage experience is helpful but not required; training will be provided.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Check loan-file information against supporting documents and broker instructions.

- Learn to review income, liabilities and financial information for consistency.

- Assist with servicing calculations and lender-policy checks once trained and authorised.

- Prepare clear review notes and flag missing information or inconsistencies.

- Help assemble application packs using approved instructions and checklists.

- Record questions, changes and follow-up actions accurately.

- Check your work and incorporate feedback before handover.



New tasks are supervised and reviewed until competence is confirmed. Lending recommendations and credit strategy remain with the authorised broker.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Strong attention to detail and confidence working with numbers.

- Clear written English and concise communication.

- Basic spreadsheet skills and willingness to learn new systems.

- An organised approach to deadlines and follow-up tasks.

- Care when handling confidential information.

- Willingness to ask questions, follow procedures and receive feedback.



Finance, accounting, economics or business study is helpful, but we also welcome applicants who can demonstrate these skills through relevant work, internships or projects.



ABOUT ASISA REMOTE

Two cultures. One team. Shared success.

ASISA Remote brings together Australian business experience and Filipino operational expertise to build teams supporting Australian businesses. Our leaders take a hands-on approach to supporting our people and developing their skills.



WHY JOIN US?

- Training in Australian lending processes, ASISA procedures and approved systems.

- Guided practice, feedback and support as you build your skills.

- A team that values clear communication, accountability and respect.

- Opportunities for greater responsibility as you demonstrate competence, with potential future team lead opportunities as the team grows.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with your CV, a short introduction, an example of how you checked detailed work, your expected monthly salary in PHP and earliest available start date. School and internship examples are welcome.

Application subject: ASISA - Junior Credit Analyst

title: Marketing agent
description:
I’m looking for a creative, hands-on Virtual Assistant to take full responsibility for social media at Relocation Homes, our estate and lettings agency in North London. We’ll supply property photos, listing details and footagewe film in the office and on location. I want someone who can take that material, bring their own ideas and manage everything from editing through to publishing.



The goal is to build a local audience across LinkedIn,
, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok and turn that visibility into landlord enquiries and valuation appointments.



Here’s what I’d like the VA to take ownership of:



Manage all five platforms. Set up or improve our pages, keep the branding consistent and make it easy for someone visiting anyprofile to enquire or book a valuation.

Plan and publish content. Manage a weekly calendar and publish at least three pieces of content per platform each week, includingvideo on every platform. Create fresh branded graphics daily using our available properties, local stories and advice for landlords and sellers.

Find topics worth talking about. Monitor trending property questions, local news and social media trends. For example, if landlordsare asking about a change that affects them, suggest a filming angle, give us a short script and turn our footage into a timely post.

Edit engaging Reels, Shorts and TikToks. Take the raw videos we upload, pick the strongest opening, cut pauses, add captions anduse relevant property footage. Adapt each edit and caption to the platform.

Build our LinkedIn presence and YouTube channel. Develop the Relocation Homes LinkedIn company page and publish ongoing postsaimed at landlords, investors and local professionals. For YouTube, organise the channel, edit longer videos, create thumbnails, write titles and descriptions, and cut each video into shorter clips.

Generate and track leads. Monitor comments and messages, pass genuine enquiries to our team and report monthly on which contentgenerated local followers, landlord enquiries and valuation bookings.

The ideal person is a strong video editor who can also write clearly, design graphics that match our existing branding and work independently. UK property or estate agency experience would be an advantage.

title: Estate Agency Virtual Assistant | Valuation Follow-Up & Appointment Booking
description:
Relocation Homes is looking for a confident, phone-based Virtual Assistant to speak with homeowners and landlords across North London. Your main responsibility is to follow up every inbound sales and lettings valuation enquiry, understand what the owner needs and secure a confirmed appointment in our team’s diary.



What you’ll do



* Call homeowners and landlords promptly when they request a valuation. Find out what’s prompted the enquiry, whether they’re looking to sell or let, and what timescale they have in mind.

* Take ownership of the follow-up. If someone doesn’t answer, use calls, WhatsApp and
 as appropriate. If they’re interested but aren’t ready to book, agree a specific date to speak again.

* Confidently ask for the appointment, offer suitable time slots and confirm the property address, contact details and who will be attending. Send a confirmation and rearrange missed appointments.

* Make daily outbound calls to landlords and homeowners already on our database. Reconnect with them, ask about their property plans and identify where our team can help.

* Speak to landlords about relevant changes in lettings legislation using company-approved updates. Find out what questions they have and book a call with our team for anything that needs specialist guidance.

* Introduce our Let Only, Full Management and Guaranteed Rent services where they fit the landlord’s needs.

* Keep our CRM up to date after every conversation.

title: Lead Manager (Sales, DM Setter and Outreach)
description:
Who we are

We are a global football career and networking agency that helps footballers get to clubs abroad. We work with players across 85+ countries and a network of 2,000+ clubs, coaches, and scouts. Our team is run by active and former professional footballers. We're growing every few months and we need someone to make sure no good lead slips through the cracks.



The job, in one line

Every player who shows interest and gets stuck before our strategy call, you get them moving. If they're a fit, they end up on a call. If they're not, they get a clean no.



What you'll own

* Instagram DMs our automation can't handle: real questions, stalled conversations, players who said they're ready and went quiet

* WhatsApp follow-ups our AI passes to you: parents, money questions, anything that needs a human

* Chasing players who applied but didn't finish their Scouting Profile or didn't book

* Reactivating players who told us "not yet" when their time comes

* Instagram cold outreach to players, within strict daily limits and rules we'll train you on

* An hour or two a week helping players and parents on Reddit (helping, not selling)

* Outreach to academies, coaches, and trainers who could send us players, using AI-scraped lists, then booking them a call with our founder and looking after them once they're partners

* Keeping every lead's status, notes, and next step up to date in GoHighLevel

* One short report every day: what moved, what didn't, and why



What you'll be judged on

* Strategy calls that actually happen with players who are a fit, and partner calls booked. Not messages sent. Not hours online. Results.



You're the person we want if:

* You're hungry. You want more responsibility and more money, and you'll prove you deserve both. This role has a clear path to running our whole lead and acquisition team.

* You're proactive. You spot what's broken and come to us with a fix, not a question.

* You use AI every day, properly. ChatGPT or Claude to draft, research, and think—not just to rewrite
s. You'll work alongside Manychat, our WhatsApp AI, and a lead scraper, so you need to manage tools, not fear them.

* You know GoHighLevel, or another CRM well enough to learn it in days.

* Your written English is excellent. This job is mostly text, and players and parents notice sloppy messages.

* You follow rules exactly. Our Instagram account has limits we can't break.

* You can get someone moving without being pushy. You understand why people stall and how to get them unstuck.



Bonus points

* You understand football or have played it

* You've done appointment setting, DM setting, or lead management before

* You've done B2B outreach



What you get

* PHP 30,000 to 32,000 base, plus performance bonuses

* Direct training from the founder

* A clear path to Head of Acquisition if you perform

* A team that moves fast and rewards people who take ownership



Shift

* Set around when our leads come in, mainly US and European evenings. Confirmed with you before any offer.



How to apply

Read this carefully, because how you apply is the first test.

1. Start your application with the words "Final whistle" so we know you read to the end.

2. In under 150 words, tell us about something you improved at work without being asked. What was broken, what you did, what changed.

3. Give us one specific example of how you've used AI to get a better result in your work. Name the tool and what you did with it.

4. Write the exact DM you'd send to this player: "He filled in our application yesterday, said he wants to move in the January window, then never opened our WhatsApp message."



Applications that skip any step won't be entertained.

 marketing and digital product launches.

title: YouTube Video Editor for Established Hip-Hop News Channel (128K Subscribers)
description:
ABOUT THE CHANNEL

We run an established hip-hop news and commentary brand with over 128K YouTube subscribers and around 1 million followers across all platforms. You won't be growing a channel from zero. The audience is already there. Our style is fast, opinionated storytelling, similar to DJ Akademiks and Poetik Flakko, using voiceovers, filler clips and context visuals.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Edit 7 longform commentary videos per week (8 to 15 minutes each) so the channel uploads every day. You get 1 day off each week, so one workday you will edit 2 videos. We start with fewer videos during training and build up to this.

• I provide the script and voiceover. You build the video around it with filler clips, context visuals and clean pacing

• Make 1 to 2 YouTube Shorts from each video

• Design 2 thumbnail options (A and B) per video for thumbnail testing

• Use clips and images from our shared Google Drive and log what you use

• Clean up audio: remove background music from clips, mute profanity, remove dead air

• Deliver finished work overnight (EST) so it's ready for my morning review

• Join a 30 minute weekly check in call



You will NOT handle titles, descriptions or uploading. Full training, a written SOP and thumbnail examples are provided.



COMMUNICATION IS KEY

Speed and quality matter on this channel, but I'm always willing to work with you. If you run into any issues, whether it's a tough edit, a deadline problem or something you don't understand, let me know early and we'll figure it out together. Clear communication is the most important part of this job.



GROWTH

Over time, the right editor may also take on story research and script writing, with more hours and pay to match.



PAY

Hourly, based on your rate. Hours are tracked with TimeProof or similar.

Starting pay is not the cap. My goal is to pay you well and keep raising your pay as the channel grows. You get a $1/hour raise once the channel is monetized, with more raises as we keep growing together.



BONUSES (on top of your hourly pay)

Upload milestones (one time each):

• $10 at 5 videos

• $25 at 20 videos

• $50 at 50 videos

• $100 at 100 videos



Monetization (one time):

• $100 when the channel gets monetized



View bonuses (paid every time ANY video you edit reaches these):

• $5 when a video reaches 25K views

• $10 when a video reaches 50K views

• $25 when a video reaches 100K views

Every video is a new chance to earn. The more videos that perform, the more you make.



REQUIREMENTS

• Experience editing YouTube commentary or news videos

• Thumbnail design skills (Photoshop, Canva or similar)

• Able to edit vertical short form content (YouTube Shorts / Reels)

• Reliable internet and consistent availability

• Follows a written SOP exactly and flags issues early



PREFERRED

• Story research skills

• Script writing experience

• Familiarity with hip-hop news and culture



ZERO TOLERANCE POLICY

Sending fake traffic of any kind to any of our videos or posts (bots, bought views, likes, comments or subscribers, engagement groups, or any other artificial boost) will result in immediate termination.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word ELEVENLABS

2. Your hourly rate and how many hours a day you're available

3. Your editing and thumbnail software

4. Answer: What is the biggest mistake editors make on commentary videos?

5. Samples: 2 YouTube videos you edited, 1 Short, and 2 thumbnails you designed



Applications missing ELEVENLABS or samples won't be reviewed. Top candidates get a short paid test, then a paid trial week.

title: Podcast & Content VA (Coaching, Instagram & YouTube Shorts)
description:
APP FORM:



Role Overview



Candidates with proven, verifiable podcast production experience, a strong eye for short-form content that performs, and a portfolio of hooks, intros and clips will be prioritised for this role.



A growing coaching business needs a part-time Podcast & Content VA to take full ownership of its weekly podcast production and short-form content engine. The podcast is the business’s biggest growth engine, feeding both audience growth and coaching enquiries, but the process currently depends on the founder. The right person can listen to an episode and pick the hook, build a 20-second sizzle intro in the style of top podcasts such as The Diary of a CEO or The School of Greatness, and produce 15 or more on-brand clips a week.



Just as importantly, this person will turn a highly repeatable weekly workflow into their own checklist, so the founder only needs to upload the files and the rest happens. This is the most important attribute after podcast experience: someone who creates the list, not just ticks it off.



Success looks like a consistent Friday release, at least one and ideally three clips posted daily across Instagram and YouTube Shorts, growing views and followers, and the founder getting his time back. Video editing ability is a strong nice-to-have and gives the role a path to full-time.



What You’ll Own



Podcast Production (Weekly)



Take the raw files after each recording and run the full post-production process through to release

Create a powerful 20-second “sizzle” intro for every episode that hooks the listener with the most important moments and looks visually strong

Edit the host’s to-camera intro; the body of the episode needs only light editing

Create the episode thumbnail (AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude can be used)

Write the episode title and description

Publish the episode, or prepare it for publishing, with a target release day of Friday



Short-Form Clips & Social Content



Find the moments in each episode with viral potential that also stay on brand with the coaching message

Cut and edit clips of 20 to 30 seconds (sometimes up to 60), including on-screen captions and text that help a clip perform

Produce at least 15 clips a week, with the same clip posted to Instagram and YouTube Shorts

Post at least one clip a day, ideally three, directly or through a social scheduling platform

Batch clips ahead where possible using tools such as OpusClip and an AI video editor

Prepare clips for collaboration guests so they can post them on their own channels in the days after an episode

Chop up and post coaching videos about the business, which will increase next year

Track what performs and suggest improvements, with TikTok a possible new channel next year



Client Support & Admin



Send recap
s to coaching clients after sessions

Prepare the founder’s week: for each client, pull together the previous session recording, notes and discussion points into Notion and link it to his calendar so he can review before each session

Design and format performance reports for corporate clients using numbers provided

Design other client-facing materials as needed

Send
s on the founder’s behalf as directed

Pick up ad hoc tasks as the business restructures and grows



Systems & Process Ownership



Document the weekly podcast and content workflow as a checklist or SOP so it runs without daily task-setting

Build and manage a posting schedule and content cadence across platforms

Flag gaps early (for example, “we missed this bit, can you refilm it”) and keep the founder on track with what is needed from him

Recommend better tools, AI workflows and shortcuts as content volume grows



What We’re Looking For



Experience



Proven experience working on a podcast, ideally across the full process from raw recording to release (essential)

A portfolio we can review, including examples of hooks, intros and short-form clips you have produced

Experience producing short-form content for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, ideally for a personal brand, coach or thought leader

Video editing experience is a strong nice-to-have and opens a path to full-time

g” and “kitchen_setup_plastic_
g”.

title: Financial Controller
description:
**MUST BE AVAILABLE TO START ASAP WITH NO CURRENT EMPLOYMENT OR OTHER ENGAGEMENTS.**



We are seeking an experienced Cost Accountant to oversee manufacturing-related accounting activities, support financial operations, and ensure accurate cost reporting, inventory valuation, and financial performance analysis.



The role combines hands-on financial accounting, manufacturing cost management, cash flow forecasting, internal controls, and financial process improvement. The successful candidate will work closely with finance leadership and operational teams to maintain accurate financial records, strengthen accounting processes, and support business decisions.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Manufacturing & Cost Accounting

- Manage standard costing, including direct materials, labor, and manufacturing overhead.

- Analyze production variances, purchase price variances, and manufacturing efficiency.

- Monitor inventory valuation, cost of goods sold (COGS), and gross margin performance.

- Review inventory reserves, obsolete stock, scrap, and inventory adjustments.

- Coordinate inventory reconciliations, cycle counts, and year-end inventory procedures.

- Support product profitability and manufacturing cost optimization.



2. Financial Accounting & Reporting

- Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end accounting activities.

- Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.

- Analyze financial statements, operating expenses, and profitability.

- Maintain accurate general ledger records and financial reporting schedules.

- Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and internal policies.



3. Cash Flow & Financial Management

- Prepare rolling 13-week cash flow forecasts and regular cash reports.

- Monitor working capital, operating expenditures, and financial commitments.

- Analyze actual financial results against budgets and forecasts.

- Identify financial risks and recommend corrective actions.



4. Financial Operations & Internal Controls

- Develop and improve accounting policies, procedures, and financial controls.

- Support chart of accounts management and ERP reporting improvements.

- Maintain fixed asset records, depreciation schedules, and capital expenditure reporting.

- Ensure appropriate transaction approvals, documentation, and segregation of duties.



5. Business Transition & Financial Projects

- Support accounting transitions, financial data migration, and systems integration.

- Assist with opening balance sheets, historical financial reviews, and account mapping.

- Participate in post-acquisition accounting activities and finance transformation projects.

- Coordinate accounting deliverables with internal stakeholders and external advisers.



Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Accountancy

- CPA qualification required.

- At least 5-7 of accounting experience, including manufacturing or cost accounting.

- Strong knowledge of standard costing, inventory accounting, and variance analysis.

- Experience in month-end close, financial reporting, and balance sheet reconciliations.

- Experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, NetSuite, SAP, or equivalent.

- Advanced Excel skills, including financial analysis, modeling, and reporting.

- Working knowledge of US GAAP and financial control procedures.

- Strong communication and cross-functional coordination skills.



Work Arrangement & Benefits:

- Work Setup: 100% remote / Work-from-Home (WFH)

- Employment Type: Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Work Schedule: US business hours

- 13th Month Pay: Provided annually

- Health Benefits: HMO coverage

- Salary: NO salary deductions; full agreed compensation will be received



HOW TO APPLY

Send a short cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.

IMPORTANT: Include a Google Drive link to your resume and ensure the file is set to “Anyone with the link can view.”

title: Video Editor (Long-Form) — Claude Code experience required
description:
Job Type: Full-Time Schedule: 5:00 AM – 1:00 PM EST (5:00 PM – 1:00 AM Philippine Time), Monday to Friday Starting Salary: $6/hr — negotiable upward based on the work



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're a growing marketing agency looking for a video editor to join our team long-term. This is not a one-off project — we want someone looking for stable, consistent work with a team that values and invests in its people.



Your main focus will be editing long form content using Claude Code.



This is not an entry-level editing position, and it's not a pure editing position either. We run our production pipeline with Claude Code, and you need to be able to work in it. If you've never opened a terminal, this role will be painful for you.



DO NOT APPLY IF YOUR EXPERIENCE IS WITH CAPCUT, BEGINNER LEVEL APPS, OR ONE-CLICK EDITORS. ONCE AGAIN, THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER LEVEL POSITION.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Editing 3 long-form videos per week from raw footage, scripts, or briefs

Adding motion graphics, animated captions, transitions, and sound design that match current short-form trends

Using Claude Code to automate the repetitive parts of your workflow — batch processing, file organization, ffmpeg jobs, transcript and caption pipelines, render prep, anything you'd otherwise do by hand 40 times a week

Using AI tools to speed up and enhance the creative side (AI captioning, voice tools, generative assets, upscaling)

Collaborating with our team during your shift for feedback and revisions

Occasionally helping with long-form projects (YouTube videos, webinars, client content)

REQUIREMENTS

Claude Code experience. Not "I've used ChatGPT." You've actually run Claude Code, given it a task, read what it produced, and fixed it when it was wrong. Tell us what you've built or automated with it.

Comfortable in a terminal and with basic scripting. You don't need to be a developer. You do need to not be scared of a command line, ffmpeg, or a Python script Claude Code writes for you.

Real editing software. Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Timeline editing, keyframes, masking, audio work.

Proven short-form experience — you understand hooks, pacing, retention editing, and platform-specific best practices.

Strong motion graphics skills (After Effects, Premiere with MOGRTs, or similar).

Able to work 5 AM – 1 PM EST consistently, Monday to Friday

Reliable internet and a computer that can actually handle video editing

Strong communication — responsive during work hours, proactive about asking questions

Looking for a long-term, stable position, not freelance side work

WHO THIS ISN'T FOR



Being direct so nobody wastes their time:



Entry-level editors. We don't have the bandwidth to teach editing fundamentals.

CapCut-only editors. If your workflow is CapCut templates, auto-captions, and one-tap mobile editing apps, you're below the bar for this role. CapCut Pro as one tool in a larger kit is fine. CapCut as the whole kit isn't.

Editors who won't touch technical tools. Half the value here is automating the boring 60% of the job. If that sounds like someone else's problem, it's not a fit.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

Long-form editing experience (YouTube videos, podcasts, documentaries, course content) — this is a real plus, we'd rather hire someone who can carry a 20-minute video than someone who's only ever cut 30 seconds

Experience editing for marketing agencies or multiple client brands

Content repurposing experience (turning long-form into short-form clips)

Any automation, scripting, or pipeline-building you've done around video

WHY WORK WITH US

Long-term stability — we're hiring someone to grow with us, not a temporary gig

Consistent workload and predictable hours

A team that respects your time and skill

You'll get significantly better at AI-assisted production, because you'll be using it every day

HOW TO APPLY



To make sure you've read this posting carefully, start your application with the word "ARUGULA" and include:



A link to your portfolio or 3–5 examples of short-form videos you've edited (Google Drive, YouTube, or portfolio site)

Your Claude Code experience — what you've used it for, what you built or automated, and what went wrong the first time. Screenshots or a repo are welcome.

Which editing software and AI tools you use day to day

Confirmation that you can work 5 AM – 1 PM EST

(Optional) Examples of long-form videos you've edited



Applications without the keyword, portfolio links, or a real answer on Claude Code will not be considered.



We're excited to see your work.

title: Experienced Video Editor
description:
Long-Form YouTube Editor for Finance Education Channel (Documentary Style)



Type of employment:

Part Time



Job description:



About the channel



I run The Capital Vault, a US-based capital advisory that helps established business owners ($2M-$20M revenue) secure growth capital for buyouts, acquisitions, expansions, and debt restructures. I’m building a YouTube channel that explains how business financing actually works: why banks say no, how lenders read a P&L, how a $2M deal actually gets structured, and the parts of the money system nobody explains to business owners.



The audience is business owners, operators, and people who want to understand capital. The tone is an insider pulling back the curtain. Not hype, not “get rich,” not finance-bro content. Think of it as the finance channel that respects the viewer’s intelligence.



I’m looking for a long-form editor who can turn my raw talking-head recordings into polished, high-retention videos that match a specific visual style.



The video style (this is the important part)



Every video follows the same visual language. Before you apply, make sure this is a style you can execute and enjoy:



Documentary feel, not vlog feel. Think clean, cinematic, deliberate. Reference the pacing and polish of channels like Johnny Harris, Ali Abdaal’s long-form explainers, and the Hormozi-style business breakdowns. Confident cuts, no jump-cut chaos.

High contrast, dark and clean. Deep navy and black backgrounds, gold accents for emphasis. Minimal color palette. Everything looks expensive and intentional.

Numbers on screen, always. This is a finance channel, so every key figure ($2M deal, 60 days, 27-point approval gap) appears as bold on-screen text the moment I say it. Big, clean, sans-serif, animated in with subtle motion.

Charts and explainers that teach. When I explain a concept (DSCR, a capital stack, why a bank declined a file), you build a simple animated graphic that makes it click: bars rising, a flow diagram, a before-and-after comparison. Simple beats fancy. The graphic exists to make the idea land, not to show off.

Captions on everything. Clean, readable, styled to match the brand. Key phrases highlighted.

B-roll that’s relevant and original. Screen recordings, documents, my own footage, custom graphics. No generic stock footage of handshakes and skylines. If a visual doesn’t add meaning, it doesn’t go in.

Hooks that hold. The first 30 seconds are tight and visual: the claim, the number, the question, on screen fast. You understand retention curves and cut for them.

No gimmicks. No zoom-in-every-3-seconds, no meme sound effects, no over-edited energy. Calm authority. The edit should feel like the viewer is being let in on something.



If you can watch a 15-minute Johnny Harris or a Hormozi breakdown and explain why the edit holds attention, you’ll understand what I’m after.



What you’ll do



Edit 1-2 long-form videos per week (8-20 minutes final length) from raw talking-head footage I record, plus a script for each

Cut filler, tighten pacing, and structure the video so retention holds from the hook to the close

Build the on-screen text, number callouts, captions, and simple animated charts and explainers that illustrate financial concepts

Build clean intros, chapter cards, transitions, and end screens in the brand style

Source or create relevant B-roll (screen recordings, documents, graphics), never generic stock

Deliver a first cut within 48-72 hours, revisions within 24

Study my past videos and the reference channels I share, match the style, then improve on it over time

Flag anything in the footage that could be stronger (a better order, a cut that would hold attention better). I want an editor with opinions.



What I’m looking for



2+ years editing long-form YouTube content, with a portfolio of 8-20 minute videos you’ve personally cut

Strong storytelling and pacing instincts: you know how to hold attention for 15 minutes, not just 15 seconds

Clean motion graphics and text animation (simple, professional, consistent)

Comfortable turning numbers I give you into simple charts and visual explainers

Proficient in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (After Effects a plus)

Reliable, communicative, and able to work independently from a brief

Comfortable with finance and business content (no finance background required, but you take the material seriously and ask when you don’t understand a concept)

Bonus: thumbnail design, short-form clipping from long-form (Opus Clip, Vizard), or experience with educational/explainer channels



How we’ll work



Paid trial: you’ll edit one long-form video from footage and a script I provide, so we can both see if the fit is right

Clear brief and script for every video, feedback in writing, workflow in Slack

Payment every two weeks via bank transfer

Original B-roll and graphics only. No generic stock footage.

Consistent weekly volume. This is a steady role, not one-off gigs.



To apply, include



Links to 3-5 long-form YouTube videos you edited (8+ minutes). Educational, finance, business, or documentary-style content preferred.

One sentence on why the edit in your best sample holds attention

Your editing software

Your availability per week and your rate



Start your application with the words “CAPITAL VAULT” so I know you read the full post.



I’m looking for someone to grow with. If the trial goes well, this becomes a steady long-term role, with the option to expand into short-form clipping, thumbnails, and a larger content operation as the channel grows.



Wage/Salary:

$500-$900/month (part-time, based on experience and output), with growth to full-time





:





Business or Contact Name (public):

The Capital Vault

title: Sales Associate | OSS Apparel
description:
OSS Apparel is a custom apparel and uniform company based in East Providence, Rhode Island. We help schools, sports teams, businesses, and organizations bring their brands to life through custom apparel, uniforms, online stores, and promotional products. Our motto, Experience the Difference, reflects the level of service we aim to deliver on every order.



About the Role

We’re looking for a Sales Associate who can build strong customer relationships, generate new business, and take ownership of the sales pipeline. You’ll work with new and existing customers to understand what they need, recommend the right options, and guide them from the first conversation through the sale.



This role requires extensive hands-on experience with GoHighLevel and a solid understanding of how sales and marketing work together. You should know how to organize a pipeline, build follow-up workflows, and use CRM data to d
 which opportunities need attention.



We’re looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with OSS Apparel and take on greater responsibility as the company grows.



Key Responsibilities

- Generate new business. Respond to inbound leads and proactively reach out to prospects by phone and
. Ask about their goals, budget, timeline, and order requirements so you can recommend the right products and services.

- Manage the sales pipeline. Use GoHighLevel to track leads, update opportunity stages, document conversations, and assign clear next steps. Follow up consistently on open quotes and move qualified opportunities toward a sale.

- Support targeted sales and marketing campaigns. Use GoHighLevel to segment contacts, build and manage follow-up workflows, and run outreach campaigns. Use customer purchase history and seasonal buying patterns to reach customers when they’re likely to need apparel.

- Grow existing accounts. Stay in touch with customers, anticipate reorder needs, and identify opportunities for additional products or services that fit their needs.

- Deliver exceptional customer service. Respond promptly, set clear expectations, and follow through on commitments. Take ownership of customer questions and coordinate resolutions with the appropriate team members.

- Coordinate accurate order handoffs. Confirm quantities, sizes, artwork requirements, deadlines, and delivery details. Work with the design and production teams to ensure they have what they need to fulfill each order.

- Track sales activity and results. Monitor lead response, open quotes, conversions, and sales. Use those results to improve outreach and prioritize follow-up.



Qualifications

- Experience in sales, business development, or account management, with a demonstrated ability to manage opportunities from inquiry through close.

- Extensive hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, including pipelines, contact segmentation, automations, and campaign follow-up.

- Excellent spoken and written English, with the fluency to lead customer calls, explain product options clearly, and write professional
s.

- Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple customers, quotes, and deadlines at once.

- A self-directed work style. You take initiative, prioritize your work, and follow through without daily reminders.

- A collaborative and flexible approach. You communicate early, share information with teammates, and adjust when customer needs or company priorities change.

- A genuine commitment to customer service and an interest in growing with OSS Apparel over the long term.



Preferred experience: Custom apparel, uniforms, promotional products, or another sales environment where orders are tailored to each customer.

title: Credit Repair Assistant & Credit Dispute Specialist
description:
Position: Credit Repair Assistant Location Remote Type: Full-time 





About the role

We help clients clean up their credit reports and reach their financial goals, and we need an organized, people-first Credit Repair Assistant to keep our client pipeline moving. You will be the first point of contact for new and existing clients, manage client files, and support our dispute team with the paperwork and follow-up that keeps cases on track. If you are detail-oriented, comfortable on the phone, and want to grow a career in credit and financial services, this role is for you.

What you will do

• Onboard new clients: collect signed agreements, ID documents, and credit report access, and set up client files in our CRM

• Pull and review client credit reports from all three bureaus (Equifax, Experian, TransUnion) and flag negative items for the dispute team

• Answer client calls, texts, and
s; schedule consultations; and give clients clear status updates on their cases

• Track dispute deadlines and bureau response dates, and remind the dispute team when follow-up is due

• Log mail received from bureaus, creditors, and collection agencies and attach results to the correct client file

• Maintain accurate notes and documentation for every client interaction

• Process client payments and send invoices and receipts

• Help prepare basic client education materials and monthly progress summaries

What we are looking for

• 1+ year of experience in an administrative, customer service, or office support role (credit repair, banking, collections, or mortgage experience is a plus)

• Strong written and verbal communication, with a calm and professional phone manner

• Comfortable with CRM software, Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, and e-signature tools

• Highly organized and able to manage many client files at once without dropping details

• Discreet and trustworthy; you will handle sensitive personal and financial information

• Basic understanding of how credit reports and credit scores work (we will train the rest)

• Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus

Nice to have

• Experience with credit repair software such as Credit Repair Cloud, DisputeFox, or similar

• Familiarity with the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) and Credit Repair Organizations Act (CROA)

What we offer

• Competitive hourly pay with performance bonuses

• Paid training on credit laws, dispute processes, and our software

• Flexible schedule with remote options

• A clear path to advance into Dispute Specialist or Client Success roles

How to apply

Send your resume and a short note about why you are interested in credit repair to 
] with the subject line "Credit Repair Assistant." Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. and pass a background check due to the sensitive nature of client data.

Job Post 2: Credit Dispute Specialist (Disputer)

Position: Credit Dispute Specialist Location: [City, State] or Remote Type: Full-time, Part-time, or Contract Compensation: [hourly range or per-file rate], plus bonuses tied to deletion results

About the role

You will own the dispute process from start to finish for a caseload of clients. That means analyzing credit reports, choosing the right strategy for each negative item, writing effective dispute letters to the credit bureaus and creditors, and pushing cases through every round until items are corrected or removed. The best fit is someone who knows consumer credit law, writes clearly and persuasively, and treats every file like a case they intend to win.

What you will do

• Analyze client credit reports from Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion to identify inaccurate, unverifiable, outdated, or incomplete items (collections, late payments, charge-offs, inquiries, public records, personal information errors)

• Build a dispute strategy for each client and prioritize items by score impact and likelihood of removal

• Draft and send custom dispute letters to the bureaus, original creditors, and collection agencies, using the correct legal basis for each item (FCRA, FDCPA, Metro 2 compliance, method of verification requests, debt validation, goodwill, and 609/611 requests where appropriate)

• Manage round-by-round follow-up: track 30-day bureau response windows, escalate unverified items, and re-dispute with stronger arguments when items are verified

• Prepare complaints to the CFPB, state attorney general, or FTC when bureaus or furnishers fail to respond or comply

• Update client files and the CRM with every letter sent, response received, and item status

• Report results to clients and the Credit Repair Assistant in plain language, including what was removed, what remains, and next steps

• Maintain a caseload of [number] active clients and hit monthly letter and turnaround targets

What we are looking for

• 1–2+ years of hands-on credit dispute or credit repair experience with a track record of deletions

• Working knowledge of the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), Credit Repair Organizations Act (CROA), and Metro 2 reporting format

• Excellent written communication; your letters need to be accurate, specific, and persuasive, not templates copied word for word

• Experience with credit repair software such as Credit Repair Cloud, DisputeFox, Client Dispute Manager, or similar

• Strong attention to detail and ability to track many deadlines across many files

• Ethical and compliant: you never dispute accurate information as inaccurate, never promise results, and never use illegal credit sweep or CPN tactics

• Able to handle sensitive personal and financial data with full confidentiality

Nice to have

• Experience in collections, mortgage underwriting, banking, or a credit bureau

• Familiarity with credit scoring models (FICO, VantageScore) and rapid rescore processes

• Bilingual English/Spanish

What we offer

• Base pay plus performance bonuses for verified deletions and client results

• Flexible, remote-friendly schedule

• Ongoing training on credit law updates and dispute strategy

• Opportunity to grow into a Lead Disputer or Operations role as the team expands

How to apply

Send your resume and a brief summary of your dispute experience (types of items you have successfully removed and your approach) to 
] with the subject line "Credit Dispute Specialist." Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. and pass a background check.

Strong experience using Xero with high attention to detail is essential, as you will be ensuring financials are accurate and up to date. , and written correspondence

Requirements:

• Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

• Minimum of 2+ years’ experience in Accounts Payable / Receivable role for Australian companies – ideally in freight and logistics industry

• Minimum 1+ years experience using Xero * Essential

• Minimum 1+ years experience using Cargowise * Highly desirable

• Strong computer literacy and confidence using multiple systems

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Microsoft 365 and SharePoint and Google suite

• Strong time management and organizational skills

• Experience with Australian GST regulations and compliance

• Ability to work independently with limited supervision or direction

• Reliable, disciplined, and proactive work ethic

• High attention to detail and data accuracy in system work

• Clear communicator with a professional, team-first attitude

title: Finance Analyst (Accounting & Financial Operations)
description:
About the Role

Pawkit is a growing Singapore-based pet technology company. We are looking for a commercially minded, analytical and tech-savvy finance professional to take ownership of our accounting, financial operations and business performance analysis.

This is not a traditional accounting role. Beyond maintaining accurate accounts, we want someone who understands the business behind the numbers, challenges inefficient processes and leverages technology and AI to build smarter, more scalable financial systems.



Key Responsibilities

- Independently manage a full set of accounts using Xero, including month-end and year-end closing.

- Manage accounts payable, receivables, bank reconciliations, Stripe transactions, refunds and provider payouts.

- Prepare accurate financial statements and monthly management reports.

- Analyse revenue, expenses, service profitability and business performance.

- Develop budgets, financial forecasts and cash flow projections.

- Identify financial discrepancies, revenue leakages and cost-saving opportunities.

- Conduct financial modelling to support pricing and business decisions.

- Improve financial controls, workflows and automation.

- Coordinate with external accountants, auditors and tax agents on statutory compliance.



Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.

- At least 3 years of relevant accounting and financial analysis experience.

- Demonstrated ability to independently manage a full set of accounts.

- Strong hands-on experience with Xero and Stripe is mandatory.

- Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including financial modelling and data analysis.

- Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Advantageous but not mandatory:



- CPA, ACCA or equivalent professional qualifications.

- Experience with Singapore-based companies or startups.

- Experience with Zoho CRM, business intelligence tools, workflow automation or system integrations.

- Experience implementing AI-driven process improvements.



Who We Are Looking For

-A critical thinker who questions numbers, assumptions and existing processes.

- Someone who understands commercial implications beyond accounting principles.

- A resourceful individual who can independently research, learn and solve unfamiliar problems.

- Someone who naturally looks for ways to reduce manual work and improve efficiency.

- Someone who identifies what needs to be done without constantly waiting for instructions.

- An individual who is curious about technology and willing to experiment with better ways of working.



We expect you to bring financial expertise into the company. Training will be provided on our business operations and internal processes, but candidates must already be proficient in the core financial tools and responsibilities required for this role.



Application Questions



Please answer the following two questions when applying:

1. Tell us about a problem you identified at work that nobody had asked you to solve. What made you notice it, what did you do about it, and what was the outcome?



2. Imagine you have joined a growing startup where financial processes are unstructured, and the founder has limited time to guide you. What would you aim to accomplish in your first 30 days, and why?



We value specific examples, genuine experiences and independent thinking over textbook answers.

title: Creative Strategist (DTC Ecommerce)
description:
I'm looking for a Creative Strategist to work directly alongside me in researching, testing and growing DTC ecommerce brands.



I'm looking for someone who genuinely understands marketing, why people buy and how to turn customer research into effective advertising.



**What you'll be doing:**

- In-depth product, market and customer research.

- Breaking down customer avatars, desires, pain points, awareness levels and market sophistication.

- Developing marketing angles, hooks and creative concepts.

- Writing copy for product pages, advertorials and video ad scripts.

- Working alongside our video editor to bring ad concepts to life.

- Analysing ad performance and developing new angles and iterations.



**What I'm looking for:**

- Strong understanding of direct-response marketing and copywriting.

- Experience in DTC ecommerce and Meta advertising.

- Understanding of Eugene Schwartz's Breakthrough Advertising principles.

- Comfortable using AI tools to speed up research and execution.

- Someone who can think independently and take ownership of their work.



Initially, you'll be working closely with me to research and launch new products. Once we've established a successful brand, the idea is for you to eventually take ownership of its marketing and creative direction.



**Salary:** $2,000–$3,000 USD/month depending on experience. Open to higher compensation for the right person.



**Hours:** Full-time, 40 hours per week with flexible working hours.



**To apply, please send through:**

1. A brief introduction and your experience in DTC ecommerce.

2. Examples of ad scripts, advertorials or direct-response copy you've personally written.

3. A brief explanation of how you would approach researching and developing a marketing angle for a new product.



Successful applicants will be invited for a call followed by a paid trial.

title: Lead Follow-Up & Appointment Setter VA — Part-Time
description:

Company: Siign-Toppers  

Pay: $350 USD per month to start  

Schedule: Part-time, with the opportunity to move into a full-time role after 30 days based on performance and business needs.



About the Role



We’re looking for a reliable, organized Virtual Assistant who speaks excellent English and enjoys talking with people.



You’ll help turn interested leads into booked sales conversations with the owner. Your main responsibilities will be following up with new leads daily, reconnecting with older leads, answering basic questions, sharing helpful resources, and scheduling appointments.



Your goal is to keep leads engaged, make sure nobody falls through the cracks, and help qualified prospects take the next step.



What You’ll Do

, and text.

- Reach out to older leads to restart conversations and identify renewed interest.

- Answer basic questions using our approved information and scripts.

- Send product information, resource materials, and other helpful follow-up content.

- Identify interested prospects and book sales conversations with the owner.

- Manage appointment scheduling, confirmations, reminders, and rescheduling.

- Follow up with leads who miss appointments.

- Keep accurate notes, lead statuses, and next steps in our CRM.

- Follow our checklists and SOPs consistently.

- Provide a brief daily update on outreach, responses, appointments booked, and questions needing the owner’s attention.



You won’t be expected to close sales or answer complex questions. You will help prospects get the information they need and connect them with the owner.



Who We’re Looking For

- Confidence speaking with English-speaking prospects over the phone.

- Strong calendar management and appointment-setting skills.

- Excellent organization and consistent follow-through.

- A friendly, professional communication style.

- Ability to follow scripts naturally and listen carefully.

- Comfort using a CRM,
, online calendars, and calling tools.

- Reliable internet, a computer, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace.

- Previous experience in lead follow-up, appointment setting, customer service, or sales support is strongly preferred.



What We Provide



We’ll give you the tools and guidance needed to succeed, including:



- CRM access

- A business phone number and
 address

- Checklists and standard operating procedures

- Call, text, and
 scripts

- Product information and resource materials

- Training on our products and follow-up process



What Success Looks Like



Success means leads receive timely follow-up, conversations are documented accurately, calendars stay organized, and interested prospects book—and attend—sales conversations with the owner.



We value quality conversations, dependable follow-through, and well-prepared appointments.



Compensation & Growth



This position starts part-time at **$350 USD per month**. Working hours and required availability will be agreed upon before hiring.



After the first 30 days, we’ll review performance and business needs, with the opportunity to expand into a full-time position. Full-time hours and compensation will be discussed at that review.



How to Apply



Please apply with the subject line “Sign-Toppers Appointment Setter” and include:



1. A short introduction and a summary of your relevant experience.

2. Your experience with CRMs, calendar management, and lead follow-up.

3. Your availability, time zone, and current work commitments.

4. A link to a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining how you would follow up with someone who requested information but hasn’t responded.

5. Confirmation that the starting part-time pay of $350 USD per month works for you.



We’re looking for someone dependable who wants to grow with the business and take ownership of keeping our leads moving forward.

title: Revit Modeler (Structural/MEPS)
description:
Looking for a BIM Modeler with strong Autodesk Revit skills and a practical understanding of how buildings are built. You'll develop and coordinate accurate 3D models for our U.S. construction projects, catch conflicts before they reach the field, and look for smarter, lower-cost ways to build. You'll work closely with our U.S.-based project managers, superintendents and engineers.



BIM modeling

• Build and maintain detailed Revit models from architectural, structural and MEP drawings, including from scratch when needed

• Update models for design revisions, RFIs, site conditions and field changes

• Maintain the right Level of Development (LOD) and consistent BIM standards



Clash detection and coordination

• Run clash detection in Revit and Navisworks across architectural, structural and MEP systems

• Coordinate ductwork, plumbing, electrical, fire protection and structural framing

• Prepare clash reports, coordination drawings and 3D views for team review



Value engineering and constructability

• Review models for cost-saving and value engineering opportunities

• Suggest simpler layouts, better material use and more efficient installation methods without compromising design intent



Construction documentation

• Produce plans, sections, elevations, details and schedules from Revit

• Prepare shop drawings, installation layouts and coordination drawings

• Generate quantity takeoffs and material schedules for estimating and procurement



Remote construction support

• Join virtual coordination meetings with the U.S. team

• Review site photos and field measurements to check model accuracy and keep as-builts current

• Flag discrepancies between the model and site conditions, and help resolve them



WHAT YOU BRING



Required

• Strong proficiency in Autodesk Revit

• Experience building and coordinating architectural, structural or MEP models

• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings

• Understanding of building systems, construction methods and assemblies

• Ability to identify clashes and develop practical solutions

• Strong attention to detail, clear communication and the ability to work independently



Preferred

• Background in Civil or Structural Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture or a related field

• Experience with general contractors, engineering firms or construction teams

• Proficiency in Navisworks

• Familiarity with U.S. construction practices and building codes

• Experience with value engineering, quantity takeoffs and constructability reviews

• Familiarity with Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) or BIM 360



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

Someone who goes beyond creating Revit models. You understand how buildings are put together, you raise coordination issues before anyone asks, and you're always looking for ways to improve systems and reduce construction costs.
