title: Marketing Recruiter & Business Support
description:
Marketing Recruiter & Business Support (Digital Marketing & Creative Recruiting)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern | Fluent English required



About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.



Our biggest opportunity right now is building an exceptional marketing team. We believe that great companies are built by great people, and finding those people is one of the highest-impact jobs in the company. We are looking for someone who loves recruiting, understands digital marketing (to ask very detailed skill based questions), and gets excited about finding the people who will help TopFoxx grow for years to come.



The Role

This is not a traditional HR recruiter position, and it is not simply posting jobs and scheduling interviews. Your job is to build a world-class marketing team.



You will own the recruiting process for our marketing and creative departments, partnering directly with leadership to understand every role, identify exceptional talent, and hire people who can make a measurable impact on our business.



We are looking for someone who understands marketing well enough to recognize great marketers. You don't need to be the person running Meta Ads or creating videos yourself, but you should understand what separates an average candidate from an exceptional one.



The 80/20 Structure

This role is expected to be approximately:

- 80% Recruiting & Talent AcquisitionYour primary focus will always be finding, evaluating, and helping us hire exceptional people, particularly across marketing, creative, e-commerce, and growth roles.

- 20% Marketing, HR, Project & Business SupportWe're a lean and growing company, so when recruiting volume is lighter or another priority needs additional support, you'll have the opportunity to contribute beyond recruiting.



Depending on your strengths and current company priorities, this could include supporting marketing-related projects, research, project coordination, HR initiatives, documentation, process improvement, team engagement, administrative projects, or other cross-functional business needs.



We're looking for someone who enjoys recruiting but is also curious, adaptable, and willing to jump into new challenges when they can make an impact.



What Success Looks Like

You are successful when TopFoxx consistently hires exceptional marketing talent that helps the business grow.



Day to day, that means you:

- Build strong pipelines before hiring becomes urgent.

- Fill marketing positions quickly without sacrificing quality.

- Identify candidates who demonstrate ownership, problem-solving, communication, and execution.

- Create an excellent candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.

- Support new team members during their first month by helping them integrate into the company and successfully transition into their role.

- Help onboard team members by sharing bonus plans, setting clear KPIs, and ensuring they understand how success will be measured.

- Proactively source top talent from other companies through LinkedIn and other professional networks.

- Continuously improve our recruiting process so hiring becomes faster, more consistent, and more data-driven.

- Keep recruiting organized with accurate trackers, interview notes, scorecards, bonus plans and documentation.



What You'll Recruit For

You'll primarily recruit for marketing and creative positions, including:

- Paid Media: Meta Ads Specialists, TikTok Ads Specialists & Performance Marketing Managers

- Creative: Video Editors, Creative Strategists, Graphic Designers & UGC Creators

- Lifecycle Marketing:
 Marketing & SMS Marketing Specialists, Digital marketing specialists

- E-commerce Marketing: Growth Marketing Specialists, Shopify Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

- Partnerships: Affiliate Marketing Managers & Influencer Marketing ManagersSales: Wholesale Sales Representatives & E-commerce Sales Professionals



As TopFoxx grows, you'll also help recruit future marketing leadership positions.



What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)



1) Full-Cycle Recruiting

- Own the complete recruitment process from intake meeting through offer acceptance.

- Partner with hiring managers to fully understand each position before recruiting begins.

- Write compelling, high-converting job advertisements.

- Post jobs across multiple recruiting platforms.

- Source passive candidates through LinkedIn and other channels.

- Build talent pipelines for future hiring needs.

- Review resumes, portfolios, and applications.

- Conduct structured interviews.

- Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and leadership.

- Perform reference checks when appropriate.

- Keep candidates informed throughout the hiring process.

- Present hiring recommendations supported by structured evaluations.



2) Candidate Evaluation

- Evaluate candidates based on real ability, ownership, communication, and execution, not resumes alone.

- Review portfolios, case studies, assessments, and work samples.

- Identify high performers who align with TopFoxx's culture and expectations.

- Build structured interview scorecards for every role.

- Develop role-specific interview questions.

- Recommend assessments that accurately measure job performance.



3) Recruiting Systems & Process Improvement

- Build and improve recruiting workflows.

- Create hiring playbooks and recruiting SOPs.

- Maintain recruiting dashboards and hiring trackers.

- Improve interview processes and candidate evaluation systems.

- Keep recruiting documentation organized and up to date.

- Continuously recommend ways to improve hiring quality and efficiency.



4) Partnership With Leadership

- Meet regularly with hiring managers to understand hiring priorities.

- Help define ideal candidate profiles before recruiting begins.

- Ensure every position has clear expectations and measurable success criteria.

- Keep leadership updated on recruiting progress, hiring challenges, and pipeline health.

- Recommend improvements to job descriptions, compensation, interview processes, and recruiting strategy when appropriate.



5) Employer Branding & Candidate Experience

- Represent TopFoxx professionally throughout the hiring process.

- Write engaging candidate outreach messages.

- Ensure every candidate has a positive experience, regardless of hiring outcome.

- Help strengthen TopFoxx's reputation as an employer of choice.



6) Onboarding Support

- Assisting with onboarding, employee experience, and company culture initiatives.

- Helping coordinate cross-functional projects.

- Ensure candidates receive the information, tools, and documentation needed before their first day.

- Partner with hiring managers to help new hires transition successfully into their roles.



7) Additional Support & Cross-Functional ProjectsWhen recruiting needs are lighter, or as business needs evolve, you may also support other areas of the company based on your skills and priorities. This may include:

- Supporting project management and cross-functional projects when additional help is needed.

- Supporting other operational or organizational projects as the company grows.

- Helping coordinate marketing projects and follow-ups.

- Supporting special projects from marketing leadership or the Founder.

- Helping create or improve SOPs and internal processes.

- Supporting HR and administrative projects.

- Researching solutions to business or operational problems.

- Taking ownership of other projects where your skills can help the company move faster.



This role is primarily focused on recruiting, but as TopFoxx continues to grow, there may be opportunities to develop your skills and take on additional responsibilities in areas where you can make a meaningful impact.



What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

- 2+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience.

- Experience recruiting digital marketing, creative, e-commerce, or startup positions.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation skills.

- Experience managing multiple open positions simultaneously.

- Exceptional organization and follow-through.

- Strong ownership mindset, you proactively solve problems instead of waiting for direction.

- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

- Must have a growth mindset, developing your skills and solving hardest problems. 



Nice to have:

- LinkedIn Recruiter

- Indeed

- OnlineJobs.ph

- Google Workspace

- Asana

- AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude

- Startup or e-commerce experience

- Experience building recruiting scorecards, interview guides, assessments, or hiring SOPs



As a fully remote team, TopFoxx uses Time Doctor during working hours for international team members. Time Doctor is a time-tracking and productivity tool that records hours worked and takes periodic screenshots while the timer is running. For this full-time role, it is used to verify and track the expected 8-hour workday.

title: Medical Virtual Assistant
description:
• Pay: USD 750 a month base, plus performance incentives with no cap. Our top performers take home USD 1,300 to 1,500 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern (10 PM to 7 AM in Manila), with some weekend shifts for coverage

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote, from a quiet room at home



A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE

Your first call of the day is to a woman in her seventies with COPD. Her health system referred her to us last week. She asks how you got her number. You explain who we are and how our team can help her stay well at home, answer her questions, and book her first visit.



THE JOB

Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit.



You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voi
, and about a dozen become real conversations. Some patients are wary, some are tired of doctors, some just want someone to listen. Your job is to help each one d
 whether to join, and to get them to a first visit within a week or so. Between calls you schedule visits, keep patient records up to date and work with our clinical team.



ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines.



WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years on the phone in customer service or healthcare

• Comfort with clinical topics: nursing or other clinical training, or healthcare work where you talked with patients about their conditions

• Clear spoken English that a US patient understands the first time

• A quiet room, internet of 30 Mbps or faster, and a backup for outages

• Availability for this shift for the long term

A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or Spanish are a plus.



This is a phone job with daily targets, not back-office or
 work. If you like talking with people and helping them say yes to care, you will do well here.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 15 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at 
 . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions. When the form asks for the word from this posting, type LUNGS.

3. Record your voice on the form: read three lines from a real call, then answer a patient in your own words (about five minutes).

4. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.

If you are shortlisted, we
 you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

title: PRODUCTION MANAGER, YOUTUBE CHANNELS (Full-time, Remote)
description:
We run a portfolio of long-form true crime YouTube channels. We are hiring a Production Manager to own production end to end: from approved idea to published video, on every channel.



This is an operations and people-management role, not a creative or editing role. It is not entry level. If you have not managed a team and kept a publishing schedule before, please do not apply.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN & DO

- The output of the production team.

- The upload schedule on every channel.

- The production board (Trello): nothing stalls, everything moves, deadlines are met.

- You manage the scheduler team: their response times, QC quality and schedule accuracy.

- Follow-through with writers, editors, thumbnail designers and voice talent when work is late or missing.

- Thumbnail quality and editing quality against our standards and SOPs. Script quality sits with the senior writers; you coordinate with them.

- Monetization and policy issues on published videos: limited ads, copyright, reused content.

- Input on content direction: you discuss what to produce next with the founder and suggest ideas.

- Monitor YouTube trends, monetization risks, copyright issues, and platform changes

- Track channel health (output, views, rpm, retention)





WHO THIS IS FOR

- You have managed a team and kept a publishing or delivery schedule for them.

- You are fast, reliable and have agency. You do not need to be told twice and you do not need to be micromanaged.

- You have very high attention to detail: you notice what might stall production and fix it before it becomes a problem.

- You enjoy managing people and holding them to a standard.

- You use Trello, Asana, Jira, ClickUp or similar.

- YouTube Studio, scheduling, QC and monetization policy experience is strongly preferred.





WHAT YOU GET

- $1,000 - $1500/month (depending on experience), plus wellness allowance.

- Full-time, remote, direct access to the founder.

- Real ownership: after a 2-week trial the scheduler team reports to you, and your decision rights grow as you prove them.

- Growth: this is the senior operations seat in a company that is scaling. As the team and your responsibility grow, so do pay and bonuses.



HOURS

- Full-time, 45 hours a week. No other job or client work during your employment with us.

- Flexible hours with two anchor points: a short morning check (before 9am Philippine time) and an evening block of about 7 hours (5pm to midnight Philippine time), when the team delivers. Monday to Saturday.

- Respond to Trello and 
 within 1 hour during your evening block.

- Outside your hours, the founder can reach you on
 for an urgent issue. This is very rare.



NOT FOR YOU IF

- You want to make videos rather than run the people who make them.

- You wait to be told what to do next instead of finding it yourself.

- You have only run your own channel.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your subject line with the word TANGERINE followed by your name. Then answer all ten questions below, numbered, in order. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



1. Describe your experience managing a production or publishing team: team size, roles, who reported to you, and what you were responsible for delivering and how often.

2. Links to channels or projects you managed. For each, state exactly what you personally did.

3. How did you track whether your team's work was done and on time? Name the tool and your routine.

4. Tell us about a time a schedule slipped on your watch. What happened, and what did you change so it did not happen again?

5. Tell us about a time a problem kept happening in your team, and what action you took so it did not happen again.

6. How do you d
 that a video is an outlier for its channel, and what do you do when you spot one?

7. Describe your experience with YouTube monetization, demonetization, limited ads or copyright issues, and how you handled them.

8. What have you set up in a previous role that nobody asked you to set up? What did it fix?

9. Confirm you can work full-time with no other job, with the hours above. State your time zone.

10. Your expected monthly rate and your earliest start date.

title: Financial Accountant (AU Experience) + Morning Shift
description:
Job Brief  



We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Financial Accountant to manage end-to-end financial accounting, month-end close, transactional finance, and credit management functions. 



Operating as a seamless extension of the Australian finance team, this role goes beyond routine processing to drive accountability, maintain strict accuracy, and deliver actionable insights. The successful remote professional will take full ownership of defined workstreams, ensure compliance with Australian financial standards, and actively contribute to continuous process improvement to support business growth. 



Responsibilities 



Support the monthly financial close and assist in preparing recurring financial reports to maintain accurate financial visibility. 

Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations, proactively investigating and resolving reconciling items on a timely basis. 

Prepare accurate journals, accruals, prepayments, and month-end adjustments backed by appropriate supporting documentation. 

Review general ledger activity regularly to identify, investigate, and correct unusual, incomplete, or incorrectly coded transactions. 

Maintain fixed asset records and support depreciation calculations alongside routine asset reconciliations. 

Support intercompany accounting workflows, perform balance reconciliations, and resolve outstanding intercompany accounts promptly. 

Assist with year-end audit requirements by preparing comprehensive supporting schedules and audit documentation. 

Take operational ownership of the aged receivables ledger, executing routine collection activities to support cash flow optimisation. 

Monitor customer balances, track overdue accounts, and ensure strict adherence to approved commercial payment terms. 

Issue customer statements, payment reminders, and collection correspondence while conducting proactive follow-up communications. 

Maintain clear collection notes, agreed action steps, and follow-up schedules to provide a complete and transparent audit trail. 

Investigate unapplied receipts, short payments, and account discrepancies, coordinating directly with stakeholders for resolution. 

Prepare regular aged debt, collection, and credit risk reports for Australian management review. 

Escalate material overdue accounts, disputed balances, payment-plan requests, and credit risk exceptions to Australian leadership. 

Review supplier invoices and supporting documentation to verify completeness and adherence to internal approval thresholds. 

Assist with accounts payable reconciliations, payment run preparations, and the investigation of billing discrepancies. 

Support employee expense reporting and corporate card reconciliations to ensure complete financial compliance. 

Maintain accurate customer, supplier, and financial records alongside complete supporting documentation across systems. 

Manage Groupware submissions in strict accordance with established Delegation of Authority requirements. 

Prepare recurring monthly spend reports, schedules, and ad hoc financial analysis to support strategic decision-making. 

Support actual-versus-budget analysis and investigate material variances to ensure financial transparency. 

Proactively identify unusual transactions, financial trends, control issues, or exceptions and bring them to management's attention. 

Maintain clean, accurate accounting records within Xero and other relevant company finance systems. 

Operate strictly within established approval processes, financial delegations, and internal governance controls. 

Assist with documenting finance procedures, calendars, checklists, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). 

Identify and execute opportunities to simplify, standardise, and automate recurring finance activities to improve operational efficiency. 



Requirements 

Demonstrated hands-on experience in financial accounting, including month-end close procedures and balance sheet reconciliations. 

Strong capability in accounts receivable and credit management, with confidence in managing overdue accounts and customer collections. 

Experience supporting an Australian business or strong familiarity with Australian accounting principles and practices. 

High attention to detail, sound commercial judgement, and the ability to investigate root causes rather than simply processing transactions. 

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills to liaise confidently with Australian managers and clients. 

Ability to work independently within established procedures, manage strict monthly deadlines, and proactively escalate material exceptions. 



Software Proficiency 

Xero or similar ERP/accounting platforms 

Microsoft Excel, including advanced data manipulation and reconciliations 

Groupware systems 



Education 

Bachelor's Degree in Accountancy, Finance, or a related business discipline. 

CPA / CA qualification or progress towards is highly regarded.

title: Remote Property Management Assistant (English and Spanish Required)
description:
Yunta is looking for a dependable Remote Property Management Assistant to support day-to-day operations for a California real-estate portfolio. The goal is to keep tenant needs, maintenance requests, records, and follow-ups moving so the owner can spend more time finding new investments and growing the business.



ENGLISH AND SPANISH REQUIRED

You must communicate clearly in English and have conversational spoken and written Spanish. You will use Spanish for tenant calls, maintenance requests, and follow-up messages. Please apply only if you are comfortable handling these conversations and writing clear messages in both languages.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- At least 2 years of hands-on property-management experience.

- Hands-on AppFolio experience, not just familiarity with the name.

- Basic bookkeeping skills, such as recording income and expenses, tracking invoices and payments, and keeping accurate financial records.

- Strong organization, attention to detail, dependable follow-through, and good judgment about when to escalate an issue.

- Ability to overlap with California business hours.



PREFERRED

- Experience supporting U.S. property-management operations.

- Yardi and Tenant Turner experience are a plus.



POTENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

- Communicate with tenants in English and Spanish by phone and in writing.

- Record and coordinate maintenance requests, schedule vendors, and follow up through completion.

- Keep tenant records, work orders, and property information current in AppFolio.

- Support leasing administration, document organization, and routine follow-up.

- Assist with basic bookkeeping, invoices, payment tracking, and reporting.

- Keep the owner informed and escalate decisions that require approval.



COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE

USD $4–$9 per hour. Final compensation within this range, weekly hours, schedule, start date, and exact responsibilities will be discussed before an offer. Please state your availability and the hours you can overlap with California business hours.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. Your current resume.

2. A brief summary of your property-management experience, including years of experience, property types, markets, and hands-on AppFolio responsibilities.

3. Your basic bookkeeping experience. Mention Yardi or Tenant Turner if you have used them.

4. Your asking hourly rate in USD, preferred weekly hours, start availability, and California business-hours overlap.

5. A specific example of using Spanish at work: describe a tenant call, maintenance request, or follow-up you handled, what you did, and the outcome. Include a short sample follow-up message in Spanish using fictional names and no confidential information.



We value reliable communication, discretion, accurate records, and taking ownership of tasks through completion.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back



How to Apply:

Click the link - 
/o/JB-EG02TR292/landing

title: AI Video Creator for Meta Ads – Ecommerce Brand
description:
Do you create AI videos combining tools like Google Flow, Nano Banana, Seedance, Kling, Higgsfield and ChatGPT? Prove it.



We’re an ecommerce brand selling to Spanish-speaking customers, doing $500K+ per month in revenue and spending €200K+ per month on Meta ads. All our ads are in Spanish. AI video ads are working really well for us right now: realistic scenes that look like live action, animations, characters, viral-style content. Ads that feel like content, not like ads.



We need someone who can create them and help us scale.



We don’t hire based on CVs. We hire based on work. So instead of a long application, we want to see what you can do.



The test:

In this Google Drive folder you’ll find everything you need: the instructions and script, the reference video and our product 👉 



Create the videos following the instructions and send them to us within 24 hours. You don’t need to speak Spanish: the script comes with an English translation. But you need to be careful with Spanish text, captions and audio.



What you’ll do if you get the job:



Create AI video ads from our scripts and references

Keep characters, locations and style consistent across every scene

Build and improve workflows so you can produce volume without losing quality

Iterate fast on winning videos based on performance data

Work directly with the founder and the creative strategist



What we’re looking for:



Real experience creating videos with AI

Strong skills combining AI tools across the whole workflow:

Image: Nano Banana, Midjourney, ChatGPT, Freepik, Krea

Video: Google Flow (Veo), Seedance, Kling, Higgsfield, Runway, Hailuo, Sora

Voice and lip sync: ElevenLabs, Hedra

Music: Suno

Editing and upscaling: CapCut, Premiere Pro, Topaz

You can keep the same character consistent across every scene

You already have workflows to produce at volume

You stay up to date with new AI tools and trends

You’re smart and independent. You show up with solutions, not just problems

Good English for communication



What’s in it for you:



100% remote. Work from wherever you think best

Good base salary + performance bonuses when your videos win

Full ownership of production. Nobody micromanaging how you do your work

Direct access to the founder. No pointless meetings

From brief to live test in less than 7 days. Your work doesn’t get stuck in endless revisions

See how a DTC brand really operates and scales: media buying, funnels, offers

Access to top creative and ecommerce courses paid by the company



We’re not looking for a contractor. We’re looking for someone who wants to be part of what we’re building.



How to apply:



Open the Drive folder and read the instructions

Create the videos following the script, the reference and our product

Upload your videos to your own Google Drive (set to “Anyone with the link can view”)

Send us a message here on OnlineJobs.ph starting with the words “AI CREATOR”. Include the link to your videos, the AI tools you used and your expected monthly salary in USD



Applications without the test won’t be reviewed.



We watch every video.

title: True Crime Scriptwriter (Police Bodycam Episodes) — Long-Term, 2 Scripts/Month
description:
I run America's Most Evil, a true crime YouTube channel. Twice a month I release a 45-minute episode built around real police bodycam footage, and I'm looking for one writer to handle those long-term.



You don't need to find the cases or do the research. I supply everything: bodycam and dashcam footage, 911 calls, interrogation recordings, crime scene photos, police reports and court documents. You write the narration script my editor cuts the video to.



What the work involves



Watch the case footage and work out how to tell the story

Write the narration: roughly 5,000 to 6,500 words per episode

Mark which footage goes where, using timestamps

Know when to let the footage speak and keep the narration out of the way

Keep the facts accurate: names, charges, dates, outcome



What I need from you



Fluent written English that sounds natural when read out loud (an AI voice reads it)

Experience writing true crime, bodycam, documentary or storytelling content for YouTube

Respect for the subject. These are real victims and real families, so no mocking and no jokes

Reliability. I work a full-time job, so I need someone who delivers on the agreed date without reminders

Honesty about AI. I'm not against it as a tool, but I'm paying for your writing, so tell me how you work



How we start



No unpaid test. Your first script is a real paid episode that goes on the channel. I'll judge the work by how that episode performs and how the collaboration goes. If it works, this becomes steady monthly work, and the pay grows as the channel does.



How to apply



Send me:



Two links to true crime or bodycam videos you wrote, and which parts were yours

How long one 45-minute script takes you

Whether you use AI, and how

Your availability

title: Tutor - CRE Underwriting & Financial Modeling
description:
I'm a commercial real estate professional specializing in multifamily investment sales. I'm seeking a part-time private tutor to teach me multifamily underwriting and financial modeling the way it's taught in a university-level real estate development program — structured, rigorous, and built around a proper textbook curriculum.



This is a teaching engagement, not a one-off training session. I want someone who can guide me from fundamentals through a complete, self-built multifamily underwriting and waterfall model, with assessments along the way to prove I've actually learned the material.



At a glance:

• Role: Private tutor / instructor

• Schedule: Twice per week (two 60–90 minute remote sessions)

• Format: Fully remote via Zoom/Teams with screen sharing and Excel work-alongs

• Rate: $9/hour USD (paid via Wise)

• Start date: Immediate, upon successful interview



What You'll Be Teaching:

A structured curriculum of your own proposal, modeled on a university real estate development / real estate finance program, working out of a recognized textbook (e.g., Peter Linneman's Real Estate Finance and Investments or comparable). You will propose the syllabus and textbook in your application.



Core topic areas:

1. Foundations — time value of money, NPV/IRR/MIRR, cap rates, NOI, basis points, leverage concepts

2. Multifamily underwriting — rent rolls, market rents, vacancy and loss to lease, operating expenses and expense ratios, capital expenditures, debt terms (amortization, DSCR, loan sizing), investor pro forma conventions

3. Financial modeling in Excel — building a complete multifamily acquisition model from scratch, with sensitivity tables, scenario analysis, and clean formatting standards

4. Waterfalls and syndication math — preferred returns, return of capital, catch-up tranches, promote/carried interest, IRR-hurdle-based distribution waterfalls for LP/GP structures

5. Development topics — land/entitlement basics, ground-up feasibility analysis, construction budgeting and draws, permanent loan takeout, developer profit and developer waterfalls



Curriculum Structure Requirements:

• University-style curriculum: You will map out a semester-style syllabus with weekly topics tied to assigned textbook readings before we begin.

• Work out of a textbook: Each session should build on assigned reading and problem sets.

• Quizzes: Short quizzes at regular mile markers (roughly every 3–4 weeks) covering prior material.

• Tests/exams: Longer assessments at major milestones (mid-program and capstone), including a hands-on modeling exam where I build or repair a model under time constraint.

• Capstone project: A complete multifamily acquisition model built by me from scratch, including an equity waterfall tab, reviewed and graded by you.



Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience underwriting or acquiring multifamily assets (e.g., work at an acquisitions shop, appraisal firm, brokerage, developer, or lending institution)

• Advanced, demonstrable Excel modeling skills (clean formula design, scenario toggles, waterfall logic — no copy-paste templates)

• Practical familiarity with distribution waterfall math and GP/LP structures

• Prior tutoring, teaching, or training experience required

• Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and dual-screen setup for screen-share lessons

• Ability to commit to a fixed twice-weekly schedule for at least 3–6 months



Nice to Have:

• Familiarity with US markets and conventions (Argus, CoStar, or similar exposure is a plus but not required — this course is Excel-native)

• Experience building development / construction-draw models

• Textbook-honed problem-solving: you should be comfortable assigning and grading exercises from a real estate finance text



To Apply:

Please send

1. A resume

2. A brief summary of your multifamily underwriting/modeling experience (deals, roles, tools)

3. A proposed curriculum outline: the textbook you'd use, a week-by-week topic list

4. A sample of your modeling work (screenshots welcome; formulas visible)

5. Your availability (EST) and confirmation you can commit to two sessions per week

title: Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator

ABOUT US



Vicky Rahmic Weddings & Events is an Australian luxury wedding, event and travel company servicing clients throughout Australia and internationally. We are growing our team and seeking an experienced, proactive Executive Assistant to work directly alongside our Founder and Creative Director.



This position is starting with 12 hours per week Tuesday to Friday has the potential to grow to 30–40 hours per week and progress into an Operations Manager and team leadership role.

Ordinary Isn't in Our Vocabulary | EA | Your Full Name

title: Purchasing/Parts Coordinator
description:
Purpose

The Remote Purchasing/Parts Coordinator is the operational link between Waldrop's customers, internal teams, and suppliers. The role supports the purchasing process by making sure the materials, equipment, and services our technicians and sales teams need are ordered accurately, delivered on time, and obtained at competitive cost.

The Remote Purchasing/Parts Coordinator promotes customer satisfaction by treating each customer as a priority, answering incoming calls and routing them appropriately, and placing outbound calls to order parts or follow up on pending orders.



Our Core Values

Upholding our core values, we:

• We are committed to fairness in all that we do for our customers, the company, and our team. Doing right by the customer every time means we work with integrity and compassion.

• We are committed to quality in all that we do. We do the best we can and show others that we care.

• We are committed to continuous improvement and growth. We constantly refine and improve our processes.



Key Responsibilities



Dispatch and Customer Service

• Make calls to vendors and customers for updates & estimated time of arrival

• Handle every customer as a priority, with empathy and patience

• Communicate parts availability to Dispatchers and Technicians for fast and seamless project scheduling



Purchasing Coordination

• Process purchase requisitions and create, issue, and track purchase orders

• Communicate with suppliers to confirm orders, monitor delivery schedules, and resolve shortages, delays, or quality issues

• Communicate with customers regarding order status, ETA of parts, & scheduling our return visit

• Maintain accurate purchasing records, vendor files, and pricing data

• Match purchase orders, receiving documents, and invoices, and help resolve discrepancies with accounting

• Monitor outstanding POs to ensure they are received and processed in a timely manner

• Support the Dispatch & Customer Experience team with quotes, vendor research, and routine reports (open orders, spend, supplier performance)

• Follow company purchasing policies and approval procedures



Outcomes for the Job

1. Purchase orders entered accurately and supplier follow-up completed on time daily by end of shift

2. Invoice-to-PO-to-receipt matching completed with discrepancies resolved within 2 business days 

3. 100% of POs issued within 1 business day of an approved requisition

4. 95% of orders delivered on or before the promised date from the vendor

5. 100% of Supplier follow-up on open orders completed on a set schedule (for example, every order past due contacted within 24 hours)

6. 100% of purchases made with an approved PO and following approval procedures

7. 100% of purchases made from approved vendors, with a target percentage of spend on contracted pricing

8. Stockouts or backorders that delay a job kept below 5% per month

9. Critical items reordered before reaching minimum stock levels more than 98% of the time.



Success Factors

• Vendor files and pricing data updated quarterly

• Weekly open-order report and monthly spend and supplier performance report delivered on time

• Accuracy of data entry, including purchase orders and vendor records

• Attending and participating in training meetings (including 1-on-1s)

• Dependable attendance record



Competencies: Skills and Behaviors Required for the Job

1. Computer and office equipment literacy, including ERP or purchasing systems and Excel

2. Positive, upbeat attitude (social)

3. Empathetic (patience and understanding)

4. Proven track record of professionalism

5. Verbal and written communication

6. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

7. Sense of urgency

8. Can explain why Waldrop versus competitors

9. Knows and understands Waldrop

10. Understanding of Waldrop's services and trades



Top MUST Haves

1. Clear, effective, and professional communicator in English

2. Dependability

3. Must provide your own call headset, computer, and monitor to perform remote work (see hardware requirements below)



Top 3 LIKE to Haves

1. Purchasing experience

2. High drive for achievement and success

3. Customer service experience



Also valued: procurement or administrative experience, and familiarity with home trades business and/or inventory management systems.



 Hardware Requirements

• Processor: Intel Core Ultra 200 series, Intel Core Ultra 300 series, AMD Ryzen AI 300 series, or AMD Ryzen AI 400 series

• RAM: 16GB DDR5 minimum, preferably dual channel

• Storage: 256GB M.2 NVMe SSD minimum

• Operating system: Windows 11 Pro



Recommendations for Continuous Improvement

1. Feedback channels: Create regular channels for employees to provide feedback on the training process.

2. Peer training: Introduce sessions where Purchasing Coordinator can share real-world customer experiences during side-by-side observations.

3. External partnerships: Partner with external training organizations to continually improve and benchmark our training methods.

4. Regular review: Revisit this scorecard regularly with leadership to identify strengths and areas for improvement.

 campaigns

Position Overview



The Property Listing Officer is responsible for securing, documenting, verifying, managing, marketing, and optimizing all property listings (individual & corporate).

Additionally, the officer contributes to lead generation, identifying potential clients and opportunities from listings, inquiries, and market research. All new listings must be published within 24–48 hours of receiving complete documentation and approvals.

1. Regulatory Compliance & MA Control

- Track MA expiry and renew in advance.

2. Listing Creation & Information Accuracy

- Create complete listings in CRM with accurate property details, pricing, layout, and availability.

- Ensure all listings meet the company’s 100% quality standard before posting.

- Post all new listings within 24–48 hours of receiving complete documentation and approval.

- Add Property Finder (PF) links into CRM for tracking.

- Update listing status immediately when availability changes.

- Remove expired, inactive, or non-compliant listings.



3. Photoshoot Scheduling & Quality Control

- Schedule and coordinate professional photoshoots for new listings.

- Ensure property is ready before shoot.

- Verify high-quality photos/videos match the actual property.

- Upload approved visuals to CRM, portals, and social media.



4. Listing Marketing & Social Media

- Post listings on CRM, property portals, and social media platforms within 24–48 hours.

- Coordinate with marketing team to ensure timely and consistent posting.

- Maintain brand consistency across all listing presentations.

- Prioritize exclusive and high-performing listings.



5. Availability Coordination

- Confirm availability before publishing:

- Individual listings → coordinate with agents

- Conduct regular availability checks to maintain accurate inventory.



6. Market Research, Reporting & Lead Generation

- Conduct ongoing market research on pricing, competition, and trends.

- Prepare periodic market reports.

- Identify potential clients and leads from listings, inquiries, and market insights.

- Provide recommendations for pricing adjustments and lead follow-ups.

- Maintain weekly listing inventory and performance reports.



7. Other Responsibilities

- Answer the client's inquiries regarding a property and assign it to the agent

- Perform any listing-related tasks as directed by management.

- Carry out additional duties as required by business priorities and operational needs.

- Assist in process improvements to streamline listing management, marketing, and lead generation.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- 100% of listings posted with signed MA

- All new listings published within 24–48 hours

- 0 non-compliant listings published

- Listing accuracy rate / 100% scoring standard

- Photoshoot scheduling turnaround time

title: AI CRO Specialist (Filipino)
description:
JWEAR STUDIO | AI CRO SPECIALIST



###ROLE & EXPERTISE###



Act as a Senior Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist with 15+ years of experience in Shopify, DTC e-commerce, women's shapewear, lingerie, activewear, and fashion.



You combine the expertise of:



- Senior CRO Strategist

- Shopify Plus Developer

- UX/UI Conversion Designer

- E-commerce Growth Strategist

- Consumer Psychology Specialist

- SEO & Product Page Optimization Expert

- Mobile Commerce Specialist

- Customer Journey Analyst

-
 & Retention Marketing Specialist



Your mission is to identify every major conversion barrier on my website and develop a prioritized, actionable improvement plan.



## 1. BUSINESS INFORMATION



Website: 

Brand: Jwear Studio

Industry: Women's shapewear, lingerie, underwear, and activewear.

Primary market: United States.

Platform: Shopify.

Target audience: Women looking for comfortable, supportive, flattering everyday clothing and shapewear.

Primary objective: Increase conversion rate, average order value, revenue per visitor, and customer trust.



Do not assume you have access to Shopify Analytics, customer behavior, checkout settings, or backend data.



## 2. COMPLETE WEBSITE CRO AUDIT



Visit and analyze my live website.

Inspect the following pages:



- Homepage

- Main navigation and menu

- Collection pages

- Bestselling product pages

- Individual product pages

- Cart and cart drawer

- Checkout, where publicly accessible

- Shipping and return policies

- FAQ and contact pages

- Mobile and desktop layouts



For each page, identify:



1. Conversion barriers.

2. Confusing design elements.

3. Missing trust signals.

4. Unclear messaging.

5. Poor calls to action.

6. Unnecessary friction.

7. Opportunities to increase purchases.



Provide the exact page URL and location of every issue.

Separate verified observations from assumptions and recommendations.



## 3. HOMEPAGE CONVERSION OPTIMIZATION



Evaluate:



- First impression within five seconds.

- Hero banner effectiveness.

- Headline and supporting copy.

- Shop Now buttons.

- Product discovery.

- Bestseller sections.

- Customer reviews.

- Trust badges.

- Shipping information.

- Return guarantees.

- Promotional offers.

- Mobile navigation.

- Visual hierarchy.



Recommend a homepage structure designed to turn paid advertising traffic into customers.



Include suggested copy, section order, and CTA placement.



## 4. PRODUCT PAGE CRO AUDIT



Evaluate every important product page element:



- Product images and videos.

- Product titles.

- Pricing and compare-at pricing.

- Discount presentation.

- Color swatches.

- Size selection.

- Size guides.

- Fit and compression information.

- Product descriptions.

- Benefits versus features.

- Customer reviews.

- Social proof.

- Shipping and delivery information.

- Return policy visibility.

- Add to Cart button.

- Sticky Add to Cart.

- Mobile usability.

- Bundles and quantity discounts.

- Cross-selling and upselling.



Pay special attention to customer objections:



- Will this fit my body?

- Is the sizing accurate?

- Is it comfortable all day?

- Will it roll down?

- Is the fabric breathable?

- How strong is the compression?

- Can I return it?

- When will my order arrive?



Recommend how to address these concerns using clear product information, verified claims, authentic reviews, and effective page design.



## 5. COMPETITOR BENCHMARKING



Research and compare Jwear Studio with:



1. SKIMS

2. Shapellx

3. Popilush

4. FeelinGirl

5. Honeylove



Compare:



- Homepage layout.

- Product page structure.

- Pricing strategy.

- Promotional offers.

- Bundles.

- Product photography.

- Trust signals.

- Customer reviews.

- Shipping policies.

- Returns.

- Mobile shopping experience.

- Conversion-focused features.



Identify which competitor practices Jwear Studio should consider adopting.



Do not recommend copying proprietary designs, brand identities, or unsupported claims.



## 6. WEBSITE SPEED & SHOPIFY APPS



Evaluate publicly measurable website performance.



Focus on:



- Mobile loading speed.

- Largest Contentful Paint.

- Interaction to Next Paint.

- Cumulative Layout Shift.

- Image optimization.

- JavaScript loading.

- Third-party scripts.

- Shopify theme performance.



Identify possible performance issues.



Explain which Shopify apps or scripts might affect performance, but do not claim to know the installed apps without backend access.



Recommend which features should be removed, optimized, or replaced only when supported by evidence.



## 7. CART & CHECKOUT OPTIMIZATION



Analyze the publicly accessible cart and checkout experience.



Review:



- Cart drawer design.

- Checkout progression.

- Shipping cost clarity.

- Discount code experience.

- Payment methods.

- Express checkout options.

- Abandoned cart friction.

- Upsell placement.

- Trust and security messaging.

- Mobile checkout usability.



Identify improvements that can reduce abandonment without introducing unnecessary distractions.



Respect Shopify checkout customization limitations.



## 8. SEO & PRODUCT CONTENT



Review:



- Product titles.

- Meta titles.

- Meta descriptions.

- Collection descriptions.

- Heading structure.

- Internal linking.

- Image alt text.

- Structured data.

- Search intent.

- Duplicate content.



Research relevant keywords for shapewear, bodysuits, underwear, and activewear in the United States.



Recommend SEO improvements that also support conversions.



## 9.
 MARKETING & RETENTION



Create a recommended Klaviyo strategy covering:



- Welcome series.

- Browse abandonment.

- Abandoned cart.

- Abandoned checkout.

- Post-purchase follow-up.

- Product education.

- Cross-selling.

- Win-back campaigns.

- Customer segmentation.



For each flow, recommend timing, message purpose, audience, and performance metrics.



Do not invent existing flow performance.



## 10. CRO PRIORITY SCORING



Score each identified issue using:



- Impact: 1–10

- Confidence: 1–10

- Implementation effort: 1–10



Calculate a priority score using:



Priority = Impact × Confidence ÷ Effort



Clearly explain that these are estimated prioritization scores, not measured revenue effects.



Categorize recommendations into:



P0: Critical conversion barriers.



P1: High-impact quick wins.



P2: Important improvements.



P3: Longer-term experiments.



## 11. REVENUE OPPORTUNITY ANALYSIS



Create a scenario analysis using these example conversion rates:



- 1.0%

- 1.5%

- 2.0%

- 2.5%

- 3.0%

- 4.0%



Show projected orders and revenue for 10,000 monthly sessions.



Use an illustrative average order value of $60 unless actual data is provided.



Explain that these are mathematical scenarios, not guaranteed outcomes or industry benchmarks.



## 12. 30-DAY IMPLEMENTATION PLAN



Develop a practical implementation roadmap.



Week 1: Audit, analytics validation, and critical fixes.



Week 2: Homepage and product page improvements.



Week 3: Cart, checkout, trust, and mobile optimization.



Week 4: Testing, measurement, and iteration.



For each task provide:



- Exact change required.

- Page or Shopify section.

- Expected customer benefit.

- Priority.

- Responsible specialist.

- Estimated implementation time.

- KPI to measure success.



## 13. FINAL DELIVERABLES



Provide the following:



1. Executive CRO audit.

2. Overall CRO score out of 100, clearly labeled as a heuristic assessment.

3. Top 20 conversion barriers.

4. Top 10 quick wins.

5. Competitor comparison.

6. Recommended homepage layout.

7. Recommended product page layout.

8. Mobile optimization checklist.

9. Shopify speed improvement plan.

10. Cart and checkout improvement plan.

11.
 retention strategy.

12. Prioritized 30-day CRO roadmap.

13. Developer-ready implementation instructions.

14. A/B testing hypotheses and success metrics.



## IMPORTANT RULES



Be critical, specific, and evidence-based.



Do not give generic advice.



Do not invent website issues, competitor features, analytics data, or performance scores.



If you cannot access a page, clearly state that limitation.



Use screenshots or precise page references when possible.



Distinguish verified findings from recommendations.



Do not modify the live Shopify store without my explicit approval.



Focus on measurable improvements to conversion rate, average order value, revenue per visitor, and customer experience.



Start by auditing 
 and provide the 10 most important findings first.



Requirements to apply:

1. Resume

2. Portfolio

3. Your findings



You may also send us an
 containing the requirements with the subject line: OLJ | AI CRO Specialist - [Your Full Name]



Incomplete requirements are automatically disqualified from the application process. Thanks!

title: Senior Executive and Operations Assistant (Fluent English) for a Toronto Tutoring Company
description:
ABOUT EXPLORING SCHOLAR

Exploring Scholar is a tutoring company based in Toronto, Ontario. Our weekends are our busiest time, and many of our families speak English or Mandarin. We are looking for an experienced, resourceful senior assistant to work directly with the owner and act as the central point of coordination across our teachers, staff, and operations.



THE ROLE

This is not a standard admin or call-center job. You will work side by side with the owner, take the growing to-do list off their plate, and make sure things actually get done. You will coordinate between teams, follow up on open items, and keep everything moving. You will not be the main person answering every parent call or booking every class, but you will be the person who keeps it all connected.



This is a senior role. Over time you will take full ownership of key parts of the company's operations that the owner currently runs personally, and you will be accountable for the results. We are looking for someone who has done this before and wants real responsibility, not someone who waits to be told what to do.



You do not need to speak Mandarin. Some of our clients and staff do, so you will use AI tools to translate and draft messages when needed, and you will be expected to do this quickly and carefully.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Act as the central coordination point between the owner, teachers, and staff

- Take ownership of key operational areas, run them end to end, and report results to the owner, with the scope growing as you prove yourself

- Turn the owner's instructions into a clear, prioritized to-do list, then work through it one task at a time

- Execute on tasks quickly and correctly, with minimal follow-up needed

- Write clear SOPs (standard operating procedures) from the instructions and examples the owner gives you

- Support teacher recruitment and onboarding

- Use AI tools to translate and write messages for Mandarin-speaking families and staff, check them for accuracy and tone, and flag anything sensitive or unclear before sending

- Step in on phone, WeChat, and scheduling tasks when the owner needs support

- Keep shared documents, trackers, and records organized in Google Workspace



MUST HAVES

- Fluent spoken and written English at a native or near-native level. This is essential, and you will be assessed on it, including on the phone.

- Very proficient with AI tools in your everyday work, including for translation, writing, and research. You must be able to tell us your skill level and give real examples.

- Resourceful. You work out how to get things done without being told how, and small obstacles do not stop you. You try more than one approach before asking for help, and when you do ask, you bring a proposed solution.

- At least 5 years of experience in executive assistant, operations, or operations management roles, with a track record of independently owning and running key processes or functions without close supervision

- Fast learner who picks up new tools and processes quickly

- Able to juggle many tasks at once and coordinate multiple people without dropping details

- Strong written communication, and able to document processes clearly

- Comfortable with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Calendar, Drive)

- Comfortable on the phone and willing to learn WeChat

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a computer, and a headset, with a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Available during the coverage hours listed below



NICE TO HAVES

- Experience working overnight shifts and weekend shifts

- Any Mandarin ability (a bonus, not a requirement)

- Experience in education, tutoring, or a service business

- Experience with bilingual or Chinese-language customer support

- Experience building SOPs or training materials



SCHEDULE

- Full-time engagement, about 8 billable hours per day

- 12:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Toronto time (hours follow Toronto's clock, including daylight saving changes), with a one-hour unpaid break

- Flexible off days during weekdays. Weekends Eastern Time are busy and are mandatory work days.

- This is an overnight shift in the Philippines, so please only apply if this works for you long term



TOOLS YOU WILL USE

Our phone system, WeChat, our custom scheduling software, and Google Workspace. We will train you on everything except Google Workspace, which you should already know.



COMPENSATION

- Monthly rate of CAD $2,000 to $2,500 (CANADIAN dollars, not US dollars)

- Where you land in this range depends on how much ownership you have taken in past roles and how much you can contribute without intervention or supervision. The more independently you can run key parts of operations, the higher the pay.

- Paid monthly through Wise, at the beginning of the following month for the full previous calendar month

- A 13th month payment after one full year of working together



ENGAGEMENT TYPE

This is an independent contractor engagement under a written service agreement. You are responsible for your own taxes and registrations, you provide your own computer, headset, and internet, and you send a simple invoice each month.



You will have access to student and family information, so confidentiality and careful handling of that data are required and covered in the agreement.



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, please send all of the following. Applications without these will not be reviewed.



1. Your resume, showing your years of experience and the responsibilities you owned, and a short note on why you fit this role

2. A Loom video (or any video hosting link) in which you: introduce yourself in English; describe your comfort level with AI tools (beginner, intermediate, or advanced), the tools you use, and one specific time AI dramatically increased your efficiency at work; describe the biggest area of responsibility you have owned independently in a past role and the results you delivered, plus a time you hit a roadblock and worked it out on your own; and confirm you can work 12:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Toronto time, including weekends.

3. Your expected monthly rate in Canadian or US dollars



Start your application with the word "Scholar" so we know you read the whole post.



HIRING PROCESS



1. Stage 1, application review: applications missing the keyword or the video are not reviewed.

2. Stage 2, practical 10-minute task

3. Stage 3, live interview: the top candidates have a video interview in English

title: Senior Accountant | Australian eCommerce Brand | Reporting to CFO
description:
Senior Accountant – Seed & Sprout (Australian eCommerce Brand)



Role overview

- Reports to: CFO

- Direct reports: Accountant (PH based)

- Employment: Full-time, permanent, employed through Remote, our Employer of Record

- Schedule: Monday to Friday (Australian business hours)



About us



Seed & Sprout is an Australian home and lifestyle brand on a mission to make low-waste living easy. We design sustainable, reusable products for the kitchen and home, sold online and through retail stockists.



We're growing fast, and our finance function needs to grow with us.



About the role



You'll lead our finance function: month-end close, reporting, compliance, cash management and internal controls. You'll work closely with our CFO and CEO as a commercial partner to the leadership team.



As we scale, you'll build a finance function to match. That means stronger systems and integrations, sharper reporting on margin, inventory and cash, and solid processes. You'll also lead and develop our Accountant.



This is a senior role. You'll own outcomes, not just tasks.



What you'll do



Financial reporting and month-end

- Own the monthly close calendar and deliver accurate month-end results on time.

- Review journals, accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations prepared by the Accountant.

- Prepare monthly management accounts and commentary for the CFO and CEO: P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, and channel and product margins.

- Prepare board and investor reporting as required.

- Manage year-end close and statutory reporting, working with external accountants and auditors.



Budgeting, forecasting and commercial insight

- Lead the annual budget and rolling forecasts with department heads.

- Analyse performance against budget, investigate variances and recommend actions.

- Provide insight on gross margin, landed cost, pricing, channel profitability (direct, wholesale and marketplaces) and marketing return.

- Build financial models to support decisions on new product ranges, stock buys, hires and investment.



Cash and working capital

- Maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast and manage liquidity.

- Approve payment runs and manage banking relationships, facilities and foreign-exchange exposure on overseas purchases.

- Work with operations on stock levels, supplier terms, deposits and debtor collections.



Inventory and cost accounting

- Own inventory valuation, landed-cost methodology (freight, duty, FX) and COGS accuracy.

- Oversee stocktakes, stock provisions and write-offs, and reconcile the inventory system to the general ledger.

- Report on stock health, aged and slow-moving inventory, and the margin impact of purchasing decisions.



Tax and compliance

- Oversee BAS/IAS, payroll tax, FBT, superannuation and Single Touch Payroll compliance.

- Coordinate income tax returns and tax planning with external advisers.

- Ensure compliance with Australian accounting standards and ATO requirements.

- Maintain the fixed asset register and depreciation schedules.



Systems, controls and process

- Own our finance systems and integrations (Xero, Shopify, inventory system, payment gateways and connected apps), so data flows accurately end to end.

- Design and maintain internal controls, delegations of authority and segregation of duties.

- Lead automation and process improvement projects that reduce manual work and speed up reporting.

- Keep finance policies and procedures documented and current.



Must have

- CA or CPA qualified (or nearing completion), with a degree in accounting or finance

- 5+ years' accounting experience, including at least 2 years as a senior accountant or finance manager

- Strong command of month-end close, management reporting, budgeting and forecasting

- Solid knowledge of Australian tax and compliance: GST, BAS, payroll tax, FBT, superannuation and STP

- Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills

- Experience designing and maintaining internal controls

- Hands-on Xero experience (or similar cloud accounting software)

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet home workspace



Nice to have

- Experience in a growing retail, eCommerce, wholesale or consumer products business

- Inventory and landed-cost accounting, importing and foreign-currency management

- Shopify and inventory system experience (e.g. Cin7)

- Experience leading system implementations, integrations or automation projects

- Experience leading or mentoring a small finance team



What we offer

- A permanent, full-time role with proper employment through our Employer of Record

- 13th month pay

- Government-mandated benefits and additional de minimis benefits

- Paid leave and Philippine public holidays

- Fully remote, with a growing, supportive team

- Extensive experience with
 and Instagram lead generation campaigns.

### How to Apply

title: Construction Estimator & Proposal Specialist (US Contractor: Roofing, Concrete, Remodels)
description:
Cutting Edge General Contracting is a licensed California general contractor (CSLB #1007180). We do roofing, concrete, countertops, drywall, windows, ADUs and commercial work in Los Angeles and Sacramento. Every job is built by licensed independent subcontractors. We sell and manage.



We send dozens of proposals every week. Right now they sit too long before they go out, and speed wins jobs. We need one sharp, detail-obsessed estimator who turns a site visit, photos or a set of plans into a clean, accurate Good / Better / Best proposal within 24 hours.



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Pacific (12:00 AM – 9:00 AM Manila). Night shift, weekends off. Long-term, direct hire. (From March 2027, when US clocks change: 11:00 PM – 8:00 AM Manila.)



Pay: ₱55,000 – ₱75,000/month depending on experience and test results. Reviewed at 90 days.



What you will do

• Measure roofs from aerial imagery (our CheckMyRoof software, Google Earth, EagleView reports): squares, pitch, ridges, valleys, penetrations. Convert plan area × pitch factor correctly.

• Do takeoffs from photos, measurements and plans for concrete (SF, LF, cubic yards), drywall, windows, countertops and small remodels. Read basic architectural and commercial plans (PDF/Bluebeam).

• Build Good / Better / Best proposals in JobTread using our price book and templates: clear scope, exclusions, allowances, and the required California contract language.

• Never price outside the price book. If an item isn't in it, flag it and request a subcontractor bid. Don't guess.

• Collect subcontractor bids for custom or commercial work (2–3 bids, side-by-side comparison) and build the budget so every job shows cost and margin.

• Check every proposal before review: quantities, math, margin, scope matches the photos, correct customer name, address and
.

• Keep the price book current: log every new sub price and material price change.

• Prepare commercial and public bid packages (scope sheets, bid forms, takeoffs) when we pursue larger jobs.



What you will NOT do

California law only allows registered salespeople to sell, negotiate or close home-improvement contracts. You will not talk price with homeowners, give discounts, or negotiate scope. You build the numbers. Our licensed sales team presents them and approves any change.



Who we're looking for

• 2+ years of estimating or quantity takeoff for US construction (roofing, concrete, general contracting or remodeling). Show us real work.

• You know US units cold: squares, SF, LF, CY, bundles, sheets, pitch.

• Strong Excel/Google Sheets. Comfortable with Bluebeam or a PDF takeoff tool, and Google Earth Pro.

• Extremely accurate. You check your own work twice.

• Clear written English for scopes and exclusions.

• Plus: Xactimate, EagleView, JobTread, Buildertrend, STACK, PlanSwift or commercial bid experience.



How we measure you

• Proposals sent for review within 24 hours of a complete site visit or photo set: 95%+

• Quantity accuracy vs. actual installed (checked on finished jobs): within 5%

• Proposals below our minimum margin: 0

• Price book items updated within 48 hours of a new price: 100%



What we offer

Paid on time, weekends off, paid training on our price book and software, 13th month pay, paid PH holidays, paid time off after 90 days. As we grow, this seat leads an estimating team.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully)

1. Start your message with the word RIDGELINE.

2. In 3–4 sentences, describe your estimating experience: what trades, what software, and the size of the largest US job you estimated.

3. Takeoff test: A gable roof is 40 ft long, and each side's plan width is 15 ft. The pitch is 6/12 (pitch factor 1.118). (a) How many roofing squares is that before waste? (b) With 10% waste, how many squares should we order? (c) At 3 bundles per square, how many bundles? Show your math.

4. Concrete test: A driveway is 20 ft × 45 ft, poured 4 inches thick. How many cubic yards of concrete, before waste? Show your math.

5. Your expected monthly salary, internet speed, and confirmation that you can work the Manila night shift Mon–Fri.



Applications without both test answers will not be reviewed.

title: Cold Calling Virtual Assistant
description:
Silverstone Independent Living provides furnished shared housing for adults who live independently. You’ll contact

prospective residents and referral organizations, explain our housing, and schedule appointments for our Houston

team. The position may grow into full-time work as the company expands.



What You’ll Do

• Make 80–100 outbound call attempts each workday. Introduce Silverstone and identify the right referral

contact at each organization.

• Write professional follow-up
s, share approved housing and referral information, confirm appointments,

and follow up with contacts who haven’t responded.

• Schedule phone appointments, house tours, and meetings with referral partners.

• Log calls,
s, and next steps in GoHighLevel. Complete callbacks and
s on schedule, update lead

spreadsheets, and submit a brief daily activity report.



What We’re Looking For

• Cold calling experience, clear spoken English, and excellent phone etiquette, including leaving concise

voi
s and handling objections respectfully.

• Strong written English and the ability to write clear, personalized follow-up
s.

• Hands-on GoHighLevel experience and familiarity with Google Sheets or Excel. Strong organizational skills and

dependable follow-through.

• A quiet workspace, reliable internet, and a headset for calls.



How to Apply on OnlineJobs.ph

Use the subject line “Silverstone Cold Calling VA – [Your Name]” and include:

1. Your résumé, attached or linked.

2. One audio recording covering all three sample scripts on the next page. Submit a single link we can open

without requesting access.

3. A short follow-up
 you would send to the organization after the call in Script 2.

4. A brief summary of your cold calling and GoHighLevel experience, your typical daily call volume, your availability

in U.S. Central Time, and your expected hourly rate and currency.



Voice Recording Scripts

Submit one audio recording with Scripts 1–3, in order. Say the script number before each read, use your own name,

and pause briefly between scripts. Include one link we can open without requesting access.



Script 1 — Parole or Reentry Office

Hello [Parole Officer], my name is [Your Name], and I’m with Silverstone Independent Living. We provide furnished

shared housing in Houston for adults who live independently, including people returning to the community who

may face barriers to finding stable housing. We review applicants individually. I’d like to learn what housing needs

you see among your clients and share how our referral process works. Would you have time for a brief call, or would

you prefer to schedule a tour?



Script 2 — Shelter or Community Center

Hello [Facility Name or Contact Person], my name is [Your Name], and I’m with Silverstone Independent Living. We

offer furnished shared housing in Houston for adults who live independently. Does your organization work with

people who need housing? If so, does it offer help with move-in costs, such as a deposit or first month’s rent? I’d be

happy to share our housing and referral information. Who would be the best person to speak with?



Script 3 — Facility Social Worker or Discharge Planner

Hello [Social Worker or Director], I’m [Your Name] with Silverstone Independent Living. I’m reaching out about

furnished shared housing in Houston for adults who can live independently after discharge. Silverstone provides

housing only. I’d be happy to share our eligibility requirements, current availability, and referral process so your

team can assess whether our housing fits a patient’s discharge plan. When would be a good time for a brief call?



Optional Practice Script — General Outreach



Use this shorter example to practice before recording Scripts 1–3.

Hello, my name is [Your Name], and I’m with Silverstone Independent Living. We provide furnished shared housing

in Houston for adults who live independently. I’m calling to see whether your organization helps people find housing

during a transition. Who handles housing referrals, and would they be available for a brief call?



Work Schedule :

Monday through Friday • Daytime hours in Houston (U.S. Central Time)

Key Responsibilities
