title: Senior Video Editor for DTC Meta Ads | No Bonus Cap
description:
We are hiring a full-time AI video editor for our Meta ads. You will deliver one batch a day, and you will earn $1,000 to $1,500 a month plus an uncapped bonus on the spend of your ads.



WHO WE ARE

We are a DTC e-commerce brand making multi-six figures a month, run by two Italian founders. We are the leader of our niche in the Italian market, we are aiming for seven figures a month, and we will soon enter the US market to take what belongs to us.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for sharp DTC editors with a real instinct for ads, who can deliver both quantity and quality without much direction.

- Full time: 40 hours a week, 8 hours a day, from Monday to Friday.

- One batch a day (one script with 3 or 4 hook variations), finished and ready to launch. That makes 5 batches every week, although it also depends on the type of ad.



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 2 years as an editor for a DTC brand that sells physical products and makes multi-six or seven figures.

- Results you can prove, with data on how much your creatives spent, and a portfolio of ads, not reels.

- You can edit without a storyboard: from the brief, you understand which visuals to use, when and how.

- You can create a video from scratch, fully with AI, without any clips from us.

- You know formats like song ads, AI drama, yapper ads and VSLs in depth.

- You use Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, HeyGen and Premiere Pro.



DO NOT APPLY IF (you would slow down the hiring of the people who deserve it)

- You have not worked with large DTC e-commerce brands on paid advertising and you have no results to prove it.

- You have not made AI part of your workflow and you do not know the platforms.

- You can only do one format and you ignore the others.

- You cannot handle fast feedback and competition inside the team.

- You only wait for the end of the month to get paid while doing the minimum. The last person who did that lasted 2 days.



BONUS

We want people who stay with us over time and help us scale, and we will be happy to pay them bonuses.

- Every $10K spent on your ads at target CPA or lower = a $100 bonus.

  There is no cap: $150K spent = a $1,500 bonus.

  A top editor can earn $2,500 to $3,000 a month in total.

- Leaderboard: every week the ranking of our editors is published on ClickUp, and the people in the top spots receive special gifts (for example Amazon gift cards and company merchandise).



BENEFITS

- You work closely with the founders and learn from them.

- We have an enterprise partnership with Higgsfield, with one call a month with their AI trainers to improve your workflows.

- We pay for courses worth thousands of dollars. Even if you leave one day, you will keep valuable skills.

- Creative strategist positions will open soon. We are not promising anything, but the best editors will be called for dedicated interviews.



DOWNSIDES (for us they are not)

- People who do not want to work, or who cannot keep the pace, do not last.

- You take responsibility for your work. We see ourselves as generals, not emperors: we are always on the front line and we learn from our mistakes.

- For now we do not train anyone from zero. You need to bring value from day 0, not after months.



HOW TO APPLY

Fill out the Google Form and follow the instructions to the letter: 

The people we select will have a short call with me, just to meet in person and see if there is mutual trust. After that comes a paid trial task, and finally a longer and more intensive hiring call.

The process can take a week or a single day. It depends only on how fast you give us feedback and reply to us.

title: Business Development & Consulting Associate
description:
We are seeking a commercially minded, analytical and proactive Business Development & Consulting Associate to support Meridian's business growth, strategic partnerships, consulting engagements and executive advisory services.

The successful candidate will work directly with the Principal & CEO to identify and develop qualified commercial opportunities, prepare professional consulting proposals, create executive-level presentations, conduct business research and support client engagements.



The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, analytical capabilities, professional communication, relationship development and independent execution. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities, recommend actions and drive initiatives forward.



**1. Business Development and Prospect Intelligence**



- Research and identify prospective clients across Meridian's target industries and markets.

- Identify relevant decision-makers, executive priorities, business challenges and commercial opportunities.

- Qualify prospects based on strategic fit, business needs and potential engagement value.

- Leverage 
, LinkedIn, AI-generated prospect intelligence and other approved research tools.

- Develop personalized executive outreach
s, LinkedIn messages and follow-up communications.

title: Remote Senior MSP IT Support Engineer (L2/L3) — Vancouver hours
description:
We are a managed IT provider in Vancouver, Canada, looking for a full-time L2/L3 technician who wants to stay and grow with us. You will speak with clients, carry issues through to a verified fix, improve the tools behind the work, and help us build the next stage of our technical team.



We support approximately 20 customer organizations, 200–250 users and 20 servers. You will get to know their environments and have room to make a lasting impact. Our plan is to settle the first new technician into our clients and workflows, then add a second as the business grows. We would value someone who wants to help shape the team's standards and support new colleagues over time.



This is a fully remote role for applicants residing in the Philippines. No relocation to Canada is required. You must be able to work the stated Vancouver hours.



What you'll do



- Own client calls,
 and Autotask tickets from first response through verified resolution. Respond to service
 the same business day, keep clients informed and leave notes another technician can use.

- Solve everyday and complex MSP issues across workstations, printers, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Windows Server, Active Directory, Entra ID, Azure, Private Cloud, DNS/DHCP, networks and backups.

- Administer our deployed Kaseya stack, especially Autotask PSA, Datto RMM and IT Glue. Work across our security and backup toolset, including Dark Web ID, EDR, AV, BullPhish, SaaSAlerts, MDR, RocketCyber, INKY, Graphus, Datto Backup and Unified Backup. Improve Autotask queues, workflows and templates; build or adjust Datto RMM monitoring, patching, jobs, policies and automation with testing, approval and rollback.

- Handle basic business firewall work, including rules, VPN, NAT and logs, on Meraki or another platform. Coordinate alerts, escalations and ticket ownership with our NOC and SOC. Put security into each decision.

- Use lighter support periods for assigned projects, documentation and service improvements. Look for repeatable work that can be made faster and more reliable through safe Autotask or Datto RMM automation, then test and measure the result. You will have a full-time mix of client support and planned improvement work.

- Use approved AI tools to help with diagnosis, research, scripting, documentation and routine work. Spot practical opportunities to save time while protecting client information, checking AI output against source systems and keeping a person accountable for each ticket and change.



What you bring



- Strong hands-on L2 MSP experience, sound L3 judgment, and a track record of owning issues through a verified outcome.

- Direct experience administering Autotask PSA, Datto RMM and IT Glue. Experience with several of the listed security and backup products, plus the ability to learn the rest. We will ask which workflows, templates, policies or automations you personally changed and tested.

- Working experience in both Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace; practical Windows Server, identity, Azure/Private Cloud, networking and security skills. Meraki experience is welcome. Solid firewall fundamentals on another business platform and a clear ability to learn Meraki also count.

- Careful security judgment in everyday support: protect client data, use least privilege and MFA, recognize suspicious activity, escalate i
 promptly, and follow approval, test and rollback steps before changing systems.

- Ability to use AI tools responsibly in technical work and interest in finding efficiencies through automation or AI. Bring an example of a task you improved, what you automated or used AI for, how much time or rework it saved, and how you verified the result.

- Excellent spoken and written English for frequent live client calls, clear updates and dependable follow-through. You enjoy learning, sharing knowledge and improving how a team works.

title: B2B Lead Generation & Marketing Automation Specialist
description:
**Part-Time | Remote | 15 Hours per Week**



**Company:** Results & Productivity Management Consulting Inc. (RPMC)



**Compensation:** US$8–10/hour, based on experience, plus performance bonuses for converted leads



**Schedule:** Flexible, with some availability during Eastern Time business hours



**Location:** Remote



About RPMC



Results & Productivity Management Consulting Inc. (RPMC) helps small and medium-sized businesses improve organizational structure, management effectiveness, accountability, and business performance.



Through our consulting services and Executive Briefing peer advisory program, we work with business owners who want to overcome operational challenges, strengthen their management teams, and achieve sustainable growth.



We are looking for an experienced, resourceful, and results-oriented B2B Lead Generation & Marketing Automation Specialist to operate and maintain our existing business development and marketing systems.



This is an execution-focused position. Our marketing tools, CRM infrastructure, and initial campaigns are already established. We need someone who knows how to use these systems effectively, consistently, and independently.



## Primary Objective



Identify and engage qualified business owners, execute personalized outreach campaigns, nurture prospects through our CRM, and generate qualified opportunities that convert into introductory meetings and paying clients.



**We are looking for someone who can produce results, not simply perform marketing activities.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Apollo.io Prospecting & Lead Management



- Identify business owners, CEOs, presidents, and other decision-makers matching our ideal client profile.

- Build and maintain targeted prospect lists using Apollo.io.

- Research prospects and verify contact information.

- Segment prospects by industry, company size, location, and other relevant criteria.

- Maintain accurate records and prevent duplicate contacts.

- Prepare qualified prospects for personalized outreach and CRM enrollment.



### 2. GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM & Marketing Automation

- Operate existing marketing automation workflows and
 nurture sequences.

- Enroll qualified prospects into the appropriate campaigns.

- Monitor
 replies, engagement, and campaign performance.

- Follow up with interested prospects using approved messaging.

- Ensure leads progress through the appropriate pipeline stages.

- Identify and report workflow errors, unsuccessful campaigns, or opportunities for improvement.



### 3. LinkedIn Sales Navigator & B2B Outreach



- Research and identify qualified prospects using LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Prepare personalized connection requests and follow-up messages.

- Support relationship-building activities with business owners and executives.

- Track responses and identify prospects expressing interest.

- Coordinate LinkedIn outreach with GHL and Apollo campaigns.

- Maintain accurate records of conversations and follow-up requirements.



LinkedIn activities must follow platform policies and use authorized methods of access.



### 4. Personalized Marketing & Lead Nurturing



- Use our established prospect personalization process to develop relevant outreach messages.

- Research each prospect's business and identify potential areas of interest.

- Adapt approved messaging to different business-owner audiences.

- Maintain consistent follow-up through
 and other approved channels.

- Identify prospects who demonstrate genuine interest in RPMC's services.

- Coordinate introductory meetings with the company's principal consultant.



### 5. Social Media Management (Preferred)



- Create professional social media graphics using Canva or similar tools.

- Adapt provided marketing content into engaging LinkedIn and
 posts.

- Schedule social media content through GoHighLevel.

- Monitor basic engagement and campaign performance.

- Suggest relevant content ideas based on common business-owner challenges.



### 6. Reporting & Performance Tracking



- Maintain accurate prospecting and lead-generation records.

- Track outreach activity, responses, qualified leads, and conversions.

- Provide a concise weekly production report.

- Identify bottlenecks and opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness.

- Recommend practical improvements to existing marketing processes.

1. **Apollo.io:** Prospect research, list building, filtering, contact management, and campaign preparation.

2. **GoHighLevel:** CRM management, workflows, pipelines,
 campaigns, and lead nurturing.

Additional requirements:

- Excellent written English, particularly for professional communication with business owners and executives.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple outreach activities independently.

- Experience working with marketing performance metrics.

- Comfortable using AI tools to support research, personalization, and content development.

- Reliable internet connection and ability to work remotely with minimal supervision.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience promoting management consulting, business coaching, professional services, or other B2B offerings.

- Familiarity with Canva and social media content creation.

- Experience integrating Apollo prospecting activities with CRM automation.

- Understanding of
 deliverability, segmentation, and nurture campaigns.

- Experience supporting executive-level outreach.

- Ability to identify and troubleshoot basic workflow or data-management issues.



## Compensation & Performance Incentives



We offer:



- **US$8–10 per hour**, depending on demonstrated experience.

- Approximately **15 hours per week**.

- Flexible remote working arrangements.

- Performance bonuses for qualified prospects who become paying clients.



Proposed bonus opportunities include:



- **US$100** for a converted Executive Briefing membership.

Bonuses are subject to documented lead attribution, qualifying criteria, payment collection, and the terms of the agreed compensation plan.

We value initiative, accuracy, consistency, and measurable results.

We are looking for a dependable long-term team member who can take ownership of our marketing execution and contribute directly to RPMC's growth.

title: Full-Time AI Ad Editor for a DTC Brand
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a DTC e-commerce brand making multi-six figures a month, run by two Italian founders. We are the leader of our niche in the Italian market, we are aiming for seven figures a month, and we will soon enter the US market to take what belongs to us.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for sharp DTC editors with a real instinct for ads, who can deliver both quantity and quality without much direction.

- Full time: 40 hours a week, 8 hours a day, from Monday to Friday.

- One batch a day (one script with 3 or 4 hook variations), finished and ready to launch. That makes 5 batches every week, although it also depends on the type of ad.



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 2 years as an editor for a DTC brand that sells physical products and makes multi-six or seven figures.

- Results you can prove, with data on how much your creatives spent, and a portfolio of ads, not reels.

- You can edit without a storyboard: from the brief, you understand which visuals to use, when and how.

- You can create a video from scratch, fully with AI, without any clips from us.

- You know formats like song ads, AI drama, yapper ads and VSLs in depth.

- You use Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, HeyGen and Premiere Pro.



DO NOT APPLY IF (you would slow down the hiring of the people who deserve it)

- You have not worked with large DTC e-commerce brands on paid advertising and you have no results to prove it.

- You have not made AI part of your workflow and you do not know the platforms.

- You can only do one format and you ignore the others.

- You cannot handle fast feedback and competition inside the team.

- You only wait for the end of the month to get paid while doing the minimum. The last person who did that lasted 2 days.



BONUS

We want people who stay with us over time and help us scale, and we will be happy to pay them bonuses.

- Every $10K spent on your ads at target CPA or lower = a $100 bonus.

  There is no cap: $150K spent = a $1,500 bonus.

  A top editor can earn $2,500 to $3,000 a month in total.

- Leaderboard: every week the ranking of our editors is published on ClickUp, and the people in the top spots receive special gifts (for example Amazon gift cards and company merchandise).



BENEFITS

- You work closely with the founders and learn from them.

- We have an enterprise partnership with Higgsfield, with one call a month with their AI trainers to improve your workflows.

- We pay for courses worth thousands of dollars. Even if you leave one day, you will keep valuable skills.

- Creative strategist positions will open soon. We are not promising anything, but the best editors will be called for dedicated interviews.



DOWNSIDES (for us they are not)

- People who do not want to work, or who cannot keep the pace, do not last.

- You take responsibility for your work. We see ourselves as generals, not emperors: we are always on the front line and we learn from our mistakes.

- For now we do not train anyone from zero. You need to bring value from day 0, not after months.



HOW TO APPLY

Fill out the Google Form and follow the instructions to the letter: 

The people we select will have a short call with me, just to meet in person and see if there is mutual trust. After that comes a paid trial task, and finally a longer and more intensive hiring call.

The process can take a week or a single day. It depends only on how fast you give us feedback and reply to us.

title: Spanish-Speaking Medical Virtual Assistant
description:
• Pay: USD 750 a month base, plus performance incentives with no cap. Our top performers take home USD 1,300 to 1,500 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern (10 PM to 7 AM in Manila), with some weekend shifts for coverage

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote, from a quiet room at home

• Languages: fluent spoken Spanish and English. You call patients in both.



A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE

Your first call of the day is to a woman in her sixties with COPD who speaks only Spanish. Her health system referred her to us last week. She asks how you got her number, and says her daughter usually deals with her doctors. In Spanish, you explain who we are and how our team can help her stay well at home, answer her questions, and book her first visit. Your next call is in English.



THE JOB

Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. Many of them speak Spanish. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit. For a patient who speaks Spanish, you are the first person at AnsibleHealth they can talk to in their own language.



You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voi
, and about a dozen become real conversations. Some patients are wary, some are tired of doctors, some just want someone to listen. Your job is to help each one d
 whether to join, and to get them to a first visit within a week or so. Between calls you schedule visits, keep patient records up to date and work with our clinical team.



ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines.



WHAT YOU NEED



• Fluent spoken Spanish that a Spanish-speaking patient in the US understands the first time, including medicine names, numbers and times

• Clear spoken English that a US patient understands the first time

• 2 or more years on the phone in customer service or healthcare

• Comfort with clinical topics: nursing or other clinical training, or healthcare work where you talked with patients about their conditions

• A quiet room, internet of 30 Mbps or faster, and a backup for outages

• Availability for this shift for the long term

A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or calls handled in Spanish at work are a plus.



This is a phone job with daily targets, not back-office or
 work. If you like talking with people and helping them say yes to care, you will do well here.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 20 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at 
 . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions in English.

3. Complete the Spanish section of the form. Its instructions are below, in Spanish only.

4. Record your voice on the form, first in English and then in Spanish. Each time you read three lines from a real call, then answer a patient in your own words (about ten minutes in all).

5. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.



EN ESPAÑOL

Esta parte del anuncio está solo en español, a propósito: en este trabajo usted llama a pacientes que hablan español. En la solicitud le pedimos tres cosas en español:



1. Escribir la palabra clave. Cuando el formulario le pida la palabra clave, escriba GIRASOL.

2. Responder por escrito una pregunta breve.

3. Grabar su voz: leer tres frases de una llamada real y responderle a una paciente con sus propias palabras.

 you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

title: Online Reputation Management (ORM) & Community Specialist – SEO / Forums | Part-Time, Remote
description:
Online Reputation Management (ORM) & Community Specialist – SEO / Forums | Part-Time, Remote



TYPE OF WORK: Part Time (20 to 30 hrs/week, agreed with you before starting), can grow to Full Time (40 hrs/week)

WAGE / SALARY: $8.00 to $9.00 per hour, based on experience

HOURS PER WEEK: 20 to 30

LOCATION: Remote



WHY THIS ROLE

- Long-term role with a growing US brand, not a one-off project

- 20 to 30 hours per week, agreed with you before starting, and can grow to 40, with the rate reviewed as the scope grows

- Fixed daily block, Monday to Friday

- Paid on schedule through Wise

- Paid assessment: shortlisted candidates are paid for the 2-hour test, whether or not they move forward



ABOUT US

We are a US-based brand selling car covers and automotive accessories through our own website, Amazon, and eBay.



POSITION OVERVIEW

We're looking for an Online Reputation Management specialist to strengthen our brand's presence in online communities and improve what people see when they search our brand name.



Your main focus: monitor and join relevant forums, spot reputation risks early, and help legitimate positive or neutral content rank above negative results over time.



This is not a customer-service or review-reply role.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Community Forums

- Find forums and communities where people discuss our brand, products, competitors, or industry

- Monitor brand mentions, complaints, misinformation, and product questions

- Join discussions with helpful, natural, non-promotional replies

- Flag forum threads that rank for our brand name and recommend how to handle them

- Escalate legal threats, safety complaints, refund disputes, or coordinated attacks



Branded Search & Suppression

- Track page-one and page-two Google results for priority brand searches

- Identify negative URLs and how likely they are to be outranked

- Build and optimize legitimate brand assets (profiles, listings, articles, videos, interviews)

- Coordinate branded content that can take more first-page positions

- D
 whether a result should be corrected, removed, responded to, or outranked



Content & Reporting

- Write briefs for articles, FAQs, company profiles, and customer stories

- Support legitimate third-party placements and interviews

- Keep a simple weekly tracker: negative URL positions, positive assets, new mentions, actions taken, and next steps



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- You have personally moved at least one negative search result down and can show proof

- 2+ years in ORM, community management, or branded SEO (1+ year is fine if you have strong, specific examples)

- Hands-on experience in online forums or communities

- Experience tracking branded search results and URL positions

- Good written English and the ability to match each community's tone

- Basic SEO knowledge (search intent, links, authority, indexing)

- Knowing when a public reply would make things worse



NICE TO HAVE

- ORM for an e-commerce or consumer brand

- Digital PR, contributor articles, or editorial mentions

- Google Business Profile, Trustpilot, BBB, Reddit, or industry forums

- Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, or rank-tracking tools



PROHIBITED TACTICS

We only use legitimate, sustainable methods. Not allowed:

- Fake accounts, fake identities, or fake reviews

- Review gating or incentives for positive reviews only

- Mass posting, automated comments, or spam links

- Harassment or coordinated reporting campaigns

- Hiding a company affiliation when a platform requires it

- False claims about competitors

- Promising guaranteed removals or rankings



WORK ARRANGEMENT

- Remote, part-time contractor

- 20 to 30 hrs/week (Mon–Fri), agreed with you before starting. Can grow to 40 based on performance and workload

- Your daily hours fall within 7:00 AM–3:30 PM US Pacific Time (10:00 PM–6:30 AM PH Time). The exact block is set with your manager

- Weekly progress report

- During training, public replies and new community activity are approved before posting



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph or
 
 NOT apply to 



This round we are shortlisting only applicants who have personally moved a negative search result down for a brand. If you have not done that yet, this role is not a fit right now.

title: Senior Remote Roofing & Exteriors Estimator (Canada hours)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

Apex Roof Solutions & Exteriors is a commercial roofing and exteriors contractor in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. We need an experienced Philippines-based estimator to prepare accurate takeoffs and bid packages.



You will work directly with the owner, who brings on-roof field experience. Together you will review drawings and specifications, work through quantities, and tighten the numbers. This is not a site-visit role. It requires careful takeoffs, organized documentation, and clear written English.



To show you have read this posting, start your application with: Apex Takeoff.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Take off quantities from drawings, specifications, photos, and aerials (EagleView, Hover, Roofr, or equivalent)

- Use Bluebeam, PlanSwift, On-Screen Takeoff, or similar, plus Excel

- Estimate flat/low-slope membranes (TPO, EPDM, SBS), steep-slope and asphalt (shingle) roofing, and metal (including Westform Prolok and standing seam)

- Estimate exteriors: eavestrough, soffit, fascia, and siding (steel, Lux architectural, Hardie/Smart Trim, stone veneer)

- Review scopes and specs; gather supplier pricing; prepare clear bid packages with documented assumptions

- Meet deadlines and keep the owner updated in writing



MUST-HAVES

- 5+ years of construction estimating, with a clear roofing focus

- Experience estimating more than one of: low-slope membranes, steep-slope/asphalt, and metal roofing

- Familiarity with North American codes, specifications, and estimating practice

- Strong written English; reliable computer, internet, and home office

- Based in the Philippines and able to work as a contractor (or later as an employee through an employer-of-record). We do not sponsor Canadian work permits.



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Experience estimating for a Canadian roofing company, or on Canadian projects



NICE-TO-HAVES

- Exteriors estimating; CSA, NRCA, or RCABC-style standards; STACK or The EDGE; labor, equipment, tear-off, and disposal pricing



SCHEDULE

Overlap at least four hours, Monday–Friday, with 8:00 AM–5:00 PM America/Edmonton (Mountain Time). In November this is typically an evening or overnight shift in the Philippines (Edmonton 8:00 AM is 11:00 PM in Manila). State your proposed hours in Philippine time.



ENGAGEMENT

Posted as a full-time contractor role. Employment through an employer-of-record may be discussed later. Unless we agree on employment, you handle your own taxes and contributions.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Attach your resume and a redacted sample takeoff or estimate. Start your message with "Apex Takeoff" and include years of roofing estimating, systems priced, any Canadian roofing-company experience, software, proposed Philippine hours, and expected monthly rate in USD.

title: Experienced Clipping Campaign Manager / VA — Content Rewards & Fraud Prevention**
description:
We are hiring an experienced clipping campaign manager to run campaigns for an established trading education and mentorship brand.



You will manage the process from creator recruitment and campaign setup through submission reviews, fraud checks, payout recommendations, and performance reporting. Our goal is to generate legitimate traffic, qualified leads, and paying customers while protecting the campaign budget.



**Experienced applicants only. You must have personally managed paid clipping campaigns using Content Rewards and be able to demonstrate your work.**



Experience working with traders, futures/forex educators, financial creators, or high-ticket mentorship businesses is a strong advantage.



**What you will manage**



- Set up and manage Content Rewards campaigns, including briefs, approved footage, requirements, budgets, and payout limits.

- Recruit, screen, and onboard reliable clippers. Verify ownership of publishing accounts and review relevant work and available audience data.

- Maintain assignments, deadlines, draft approvals, revisions, live post links, and creator communication.

- Review clips for accuracy, quality, branding, appropriate disclosures, and a clear next step.

- Investigate signs of bought views, bots, engagement exchanges, undisclosed boosting, duplicate submissions, or manipulated evidence.

- Check available native analytics, traffic sources, audience geography, watch/retention data, and account history.

- Prepare evidence-based recommendations to approve, investigate, or reject submissions and payment requests. Escalate issues to platform support when needed.

- Set up creator-specific tracking and preserve referral information through landing pages, applications, bookings, and customer records.

- Match customer bonuses to verified payments and refunds under the agreed rules.

- Maintain a budget and performance dashboard covering delivery, traffic, qualified applications, attended calls, customers, collections, refunds, and acquisition cost.

- Recommend improvements based on actual results.



We need someone who can run the daily operation independently, keep records organized, and bring problems to us with evidence and a proposed solution.



**Required experience**



- Personally managed at least two paid clipping campaigns, including submission reviews and creator payment checks.

- Hands-on experience with Content Rewards beyond submitting your own clips.

- Experience reviewing suspicious traffic and documenting fraud investigations.

- Ability to distinguish genuine low-converting traffic from evidence of manipulated engagement.

- Experience maintaining campaign budgets, tracking links, spreadsheets, or CRM reports.

- Strong written English, reliable communication, and consistent follow-through.



**Strong advantages**



- Previous work with trading educators, traders, financial creators, or online mentorship businesses.

- Experience connecting short-form content to YouTube training, applications, sales calls, and verified purchases.

- Experience measuring paid membership acquisition and renewals.

- Ability to write practical procedures and train clippers to follow them.



**How to apply**



Start your application with **CLIPPING OPERATOR** and answer these questions:



1. **Describe two clipping campaigns you personally managed.** Include the niche, approximate budget, platforms, number of active clippers, your responsibilities, and results you can substantiate.

2. **Show your Content Rewards experience.** Share a short Loom walkthrough or screenshots demonstrating your campaign-management work. Use material you have permission to share and redact confidential information.

3. **Describe a specific fraud investigation.** What raised your concern, what evidence did you check, what action did you take, and what happened? Distinguish confirmed findings from suspicions.

4. **Explain your screening process.** How would you vet a clipper and review a suspicious submission before recommending payment?

5. **Explain your tracking experience.** How have you tracked clips through to leads or sales? What tools did you use, and how did you handle missing attribution?

6. **Describe any trading-industry experience.** Who did you work with, and what was your exact role?

7. **Provide your expected part-time rate, weekly availability, availability for Pacific Time check-ins, and earliest start date.**



Applications must include specific answers and evidence of relevant experience.



Shortlisted applicants will be interviewed and complete a paid trial assignment.



We are looking for an experienced operator who can build a reliable clipping operation and help us judge success through real business results.

title: AI VIDEO EDITOR — YOUTUBE FACELESS CHANNELS

We’re building a growing portfolio of faceless YouTube channels and need someone who understands storytelling, pacing, and audience retention—not just how to generate individual clips. You’ll receive scripts, voiceovers, music files, and creative direction, then use your editing and AI skills to bring each video to life.

- Strong hands-on experience with AI video generation and AI-assisted editing tools.

- Ability to manage the full process independently: prompting, generating visuals, editing, and delivering the final video.

title: Accountant (Xero + Shopify) | Australian eCommerce Brand
description:
Accountant – Seed & Sprout (Australian eCommerce Brand)



Role overview

- Reports to: Senior Accountant / Finance Manager

- Location: Remote, work from home (Philippines)

- Employment: Full-time, permanent, employed through Remote, our Employer of Record

- Schedule: Monday to Friday



About us



Seed & Sprout is an Australian home and lifestyle brand on a mission to make low-waste living easy. We design sustainable, reusable products for the kitchen and home, sold online and through retail stockists.



We're growing fast, and so is our finance team.



About the role



You'll keep our day-to-day finance running accurately and on time: transactional accounting, reconciliations and month-end across our eCommerce, wholesale and inventory operations.



This role suits someone who understands how Shopify, payment gateways, inventory systems and Xero connect. We want someone who fixes discrepancies at the source and looks for ways to automate and simplify.



What you'll do



Accounts payable and receivable

- Process supplier invoices, expense claims and payment runs, including foreign-currency payments to overseas suppliers.

- Raise wholesale invoices, manage customer accounts and follow up overdue accounts.

- Keep supplier and customer records accurate and audit-ready.



Reconciliations

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards and clearing accounts daily or weekly.

- Reconcile Shopify, payment gateway, marketplace and buy-now-pay-later settlements to the general ledger. This includes fees, refunds, chargebacks and gift cards.

- Investigate integration and transaction discrepancies through to root cause.

- Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations.



Month-end and reporting

- Prepare month-end journals, accruals and prepayments.

- Prepare sales, cash and working capital reports, and flag trends and anomalies.

- Help with management reports, budgets and forecasts.



Inventory and cost of goods

- Support stock reconciliations, stocktakes and adjustments with our operations and warehouse teams.

- Record purchase orders and shipment costs (freight, duty, customs) so landed costs and COGS are correct.

- Reconcile the inventory system to the general ledger each month.



Systems and process improvement

- Maintain the data flow between Shopify, our inventory system, payment gateways and Xero.

- Automate manual tasks, tighten controls and document the processes you own.



Must have

- Degree in accounting or finance, or currently studying CA/CPA

- 2+ years' experience as an accountant, assistant accountant or senior bookkeeper

- Hands-on Xero experience (or similar cloud accounting software)

- Working knowledge of Australian GST, BAS, payroll and superannuation

- Strong reconciliation skills: you find the problem and fix it

- Strong Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, data clean-up)

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet home workspace



Nice to have

- Experience with a retail, wholesale or eCommerce business with multiple sales channels

- Shopify, payment gateway, BNPL or inventory system experience (e.g. Cin7)

- Inventory accounting, landed costs, imports or foreign-currency transactions



What we offer

- A permanent, full-time role with proper employment through our Employer of Record

- 13th month pay

- Government-mandated benefits and additional de minimis benefits

- Paid leave and Philippine public holidays

title: AI Video Editor for Meta Ads (DTC, Full-Time)
description:
This is a full-time, remote role with a base of $1,000 to $1,500 a month and a $100 bonus for every $10K your ads spend, with no cap.



WHO WE ARE

We are a DTC e-commerce brand making multi-six figures a month, run by two Italian founders. We are the leader of our niche in the Italian market, we are aiming for seven figures a month, and we will soon enter the US market to take what belongs to us.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for sharp DTC editors with a real instinct for ads, who can deliver both quantity and quality without much direction.

- Full time: 40 hours a week, 8 hours a day, from Monday to Friday.

- One batch a day (one script with 3 or 4 hook variations), finished and ready to launch. That makes 5 batches every week, although it also depends on the type of ad.



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 2 years as an editor for a DTC brand that sells physical products and makes multi-six or seven figures.

- Results you can prove, with data on how much your creatives spent, and a portfolio of ads, not reels.

- You can edit without a storyboard: from the brief, you understand which visuals to use, when and how.

- You can create a video from scratch, fully with AI, without any clips from us.

- You know formats like song ads, AI drama, yapper ads and VSLs in depth.

- You use Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, HeyGen and Premiere Pro.



DO NOT APPLY IF (you would slow down the hiring of the people who deserve it)

- You have not worked with large DTC e-commerce brands on paid advertising and you have no results to prove it.

- You have not made AI part of your workflow and you do not know the platforms.

- You can only do one format and you ignore the others.

- You cannot handle fast feedback and competition inside the team.

- You only wait for the end of the month to get paid while doing the minimum. The last person who did that lasted 2 days.



BONUS

We want people who stay with us over time and help us scale, and we will be happy to pay them bonuses.

- Every $10K spent on your ads at target CPA or lower = a $100 bonus.

  There is no cap: $150K spent = a $1,500 bonus.

  A top editor can earn $2,500 to $3,000 a month in total.

- Leaderboard: every week the ranking of our editors is published on ClickUp, and the people in the top spots receive special gifts (for example Amazon gift cards and company merchandise).



BENEFITS

- You work closely with the founders and learn from them.

- We have an enterprise partnership with Higgsfield, with one call a month with their AI trainers to improve your workflows.

- We pay for courses worth thousands of dollars. Even if you leave one day, you will keep valuable skills.

- Creative strategist positions will open soon. We are not promising anything, but the best editors will be called for dedicated interviews.



DOWNSIDES (for us they are not)

- People who do not want to work, or who cannot keep the pace, do not last.

- You take responsibility for your work. We see ourselves as generals, not emperors: we are always on the front line and we learn from our mistakes.

- For now we do not train anyone from zero. You need to bring value from day 0, not after months.



HOW TO APPLY

Fill out the Google Form and follow the instructions to the letter: 

The people we select will have a short call with me, just to meet in person and see if there is mutual trust. After that comes a paid trial task, and finally a longer and more intensive hiring call.

The process can take a week or a single day. It depends only on how fast you give us feedback and reply to us.

title: SEO & AI Search Support Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced SEO specialist to provide ongoing implementation, research and optimisation support across a portfolio of Shopify websites operating in Australia and international markets.



This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable working across technical SEO, eCommerce/Shopify, multi-level keyword research, performance optimisations, and newer search areas such as AI Search, GEO and AEO.



You will work alongside an experienced SEO lead who will provide strategic direction, priorities and governance. Your role will focus primarily on execution, analysis, QA and progressing optimisation work across multiple websites.



Scope of Work



Typical responsibilities will include:

- Technical SEO audits and follow-up checks

- Google Search Console analysis

- Semrush research and reporting

- Keyword research and topic clustering

- Competitor and search landscape analysis

- Metadata creation and optimisation

- Internal linking reviews and recommendations

- Crawlability and indexation analysis

- Navigation and site architecture reviews

- Schema markup reviews and validation

- Content optimisation recommendations

- Redirect mapping and migration support

- International SEO support, including hreflang tags etc

- Ongoing monitoring of organic search performance

- AI Search, GEO and AEO initiatives

- Entity optimisation and AI discoverability research

- Identifying issues with AI-generated content and search quality

- Supporting monthly and ad-hoc SEO reporting



The work will span ecommerce sites and product categories, so you must be comfortable switching between different websites, markets and priorities.



What We Are Looking For

- You should have at least 4+ years of technical SEO experience, ideally with Shopify websites.

- AI Search Experience



We are also looking for someone who understands how search is changing beyond traditional Google results.



You should have working knowledge of:

- AI Search

- Generative Engine Optimisation, or GEO

- Answer Engine Optimisation, or AEO

- Responsible use of AI for research, content analysis and optimisation



We are looking for someone who understands how AI is influencing organic search and can apply that knowledge to real ecommerce SEO work.



How You Will Work

This is not a role where you will be expected to create the entire SEO strategy independently. Strategic direction, major priorities and governance will be provided.



You will be expected to:

Follow defined SEO frameworks and processes

Complete work accurately and independently

Document findings clearly

Flag issues when something requires strategic review

Execute multiple tasks across different brands

Maintain strong attention to detail

Deliver work consistently without requiring constant supervision



To Apply

Please include:

A short summary of your SEO experience (1-2 paragraphs are enough, make them crisp)

Examples of ecommerce websites you have worked on with evidence

Your experience with Google Search Console, Semrush and Screaming Frog

An example of a technical SEO issue you identified and how you approached it

Your experience with AI Search, GEO or AEO



NOTE: Please avoid generic AI-generated applications. We will filter those out immediately i.e. taking our job description and flipping it around using AI doesn't speak well to us.



We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate practical SEO experience, sound judgement and the ability to execute consistently across multiple websites. Please note there will be a technical interview with the SEO lead following the initial application.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
CONTRACT UI/UX DESIGNER



=== ABOUT ESHOPPING GROUP ===



We're an e-commerce success story with operations across Sydney, Perth, and Brisbane, and an international team of 50+ spanning Australia, US, Philippines, Vietnam, China, and UK. Our portfolio includes seven brands across Beauty, Consumer Electronics, Pets, Surveillance, and Wellness. We operate out of WeWork on Pitt St with a flexible, fast-paced culture that rewards initiative and creativity.



=== WHY JOIN US? ===



- International team: Collaborate with 50+ people across six countries.

- Career growth alignment: We invest in people with vision and ambition.

- Expert mentoring: Learn from leaders recognised as Top 50 People in Australian ecommerce.

- Shared success: Your performance directly contributes to business growth.



=== THE ROLE ===



As we continue to scale multiple brands, we are seeking a Contract UI/UX Designer to join our team part time. This role sits within our in-house creative team and is ideal for a hands-on designer with strong UI/UX, ecommerce, and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) experience. You'll enjoy solving digital problems across multiple brands and turning ideas into intuitive, high-performing experiences.



You'll work closely with our Design & Experience Lead and broader creative, ecommerce, marketing, and product teams, taking ownership of digital projects from brief through to final design and developer handover.



A key part of the role will be supporting and executing our CRO program. You'll be expected to set up and launch A/B tests using platforms such as Elevate, Intelligems, or similar tools, conduct pre- and post-experiment data analysis, and translate insights into actionable design and optimisation recommendations.



=== KEY RESPONSIBILITIES ===



- UI/UX Design: Design and improve digital experiences across multiple ecommerce brands, including landing pages, website pages, collection experiences, navigation, and other website enhancements.



- Landing Pages & Website Design: Own projects from brief and initial UX thinking through to wireframes, high-fidelity UI design, prototyping, and developer handover, ensuring solutions are both user-friendly and commercially effective.



- UX & Customer Journeys: Map customer journeys, identify friction points, and translate user needs, behavioural insights, and business objectives into clear, intuitive digital experiences.



- CRO & A/B Testing: Identify optimisation opportunities, develop data-informed hypotheses, design test variations, and independently set up, configure, and launch A/B tests using Elevate, Intelligems, or similar experimentation platforms.



- Pre- & Post-Experiment Analysis: Establish performance baselines, assess opportunities using existing data, monitor experiment performance, and analyse results to evaluate outcomes and identify actionable recommendations for ongoing conversion optimisation.



- Design Systems: Work within and contribute to existing design systems and brand guidelines, ensuring consistency while adapting digital experiences to suit different brands and audiences.



- Shopify Design: Design and support front-end improvements across Shopify websites, with a strong understanding of the platform's capabilities and limitations.



- Creative Collaboration: Work closely within the creative team alongside digital designers, graphic designers, copywriters, and content creators to deliver cohesive, high-quality digital experiences.



- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with marketing, ecommerce, product, development, and data teams to deliver design solutions that balance user needs, brand, and commercial objectives.



=== REQUIREMENTS ===



- 2-4 years' experience as a UI/UX or Digital Designer, ideally within ecommerce, agency, or fast-paced digital environments.

- Strong practical experience designing for ecommerce websites, with a portfolio demonstrating real-world website, landing page, and UX work.

- Advanced Figma skills, with experience creating wireframes, high-fidelity designs, prototypes, and developer-ready handovers.

- Strong Shopify experience and a solid understanding of working within Shopify's front-end environment.

- Hands-on A/B testing experience, including setting up, configuring, and launching experiments in Elevate, Intelligems, or similar CRO and experimentation platforms.

- Confident with pre- and post-experiment data analysis, including establishing performance baselines, evaluating test results, interpreting key ecommerce metrics, and making data-informed recommendations.

- Strong understanding of CRO principles, experimentation methodology, hypothesis development, and how to design tests that balance user experience with commercial objectives.

title: Sales Closer – Local Service Business Clients – $4-15/hr + Uncapped Commission (US Hours)
description:
We run The GRID — a done-for-you growth system for local service businesses in the US (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, and similar trades). We're hiring one person to run our outbound sales process end to end: reach out to business owners, show them a real, specific problem with their online presence (their website, their Google listing, how they handle missed calls), and close them into a paid engagement.



This is not a script-reading, dial-and-transfer job. You'll need to actually understand what we do well enough to look at a business's website and Google listing and explain, in plain language, what's likely costing them money — then close the deal yourself, with no handoff. If your background is high-volume generic cold-calling or appointment-setting with no interest in understanding the product, please don't apply — you won't pass the first screen and it'll waste both our time.



What you'll do:



Call and
 US local service business owners, opening with a specific, real observation about their business — never a generic pitch. Review a prospect's website and Google Business Profile before or during the call to find real gaps (no online booking, thin reviews, outdated site, no after-hours coverage). Walk owners through our guarantee ($2,000 in real findings, in writing, or we pay them $1,000) as the core of the pitch. Close the deal yourself — there is no separate closer, you are the closer. Log every call and outcome accurately.



What you need:



Fluent, clear spoken English. You will be on live calls with US business owners. This is the single hard requirement — your application video is how we check it, not your resume. Real closing experience — not just appointment-setting or lead qualification. Comfortable learning enough about websites, Google Business Profiles, and basic CRM tools (we use GoHighLevel) to talk credibly about a business's gaps — you don't need to be technical. Able to work US business hours — state your actual overlap in hours in your application. A quiet space and reliable internet for calls; reliable and self-directed day to day.



Pay:



Open range: $6/hr up to a $15/hr cap, plus uncapped commission on every deal you close, from day one.



As a rough monthly reference at full-time hours (160 hrs/month), that's roughly $960–$2,400/month base, before any commission — commission is where real earning happens here, and there's no ceiling on it. Lower base + higher commission will out-earn higher base + lower commission for anyone actually closing deals. If you'd rather have more guaranteed income with a smaller cut per deal, that's available too, capped at $15/hr base.



Tell us in your application where on this $4-15/hr range you'd want to start, and why. There's no wrong answer — we want to see how you think about risk and reward before we ever get on a call.



Hours: 15-30+/week to start, scaling with output and results.



How to apply:



Start your application with the word PHOENIX — if it doesn't start with that word, we assume you didn't read the full post and we won't review it.

Send a 60-90 second voice or video recording telling us about your sales/closing experience and why you'd be good at this. Voice note is fine — we're listening for how you communicate, not production quality.

In writing, tell us: your available hours and overlap with US business hours (Eastern or Central time), and where on the $6-15/hr range you'd want to start and why.



Applications that skip the PHOENIX keyword or the voice/video clip will not be reviewed, regardless of resume.

description:
PFS Global is seeking to hire a remote, tech savvy System Administrator to work for our full-service business management company which is located in California, United States. This is a dual-purpose role focused on modernizing our infrastructure and providing high-level technical support. You will be instrumental in our transition from legacy on-premise setups to a cloud-first architecture. We are looking to fill this position immediately. Please only apply if you meet the below qualifications:

2. Must have minimum internet speeds of 25/25 mbps (download/upload)

Key Responsibilities:

• Project Work (70%): Infrastructure deployment, Azure management, automation, and cloud migration.

The ideal candidate doesn't need 10 years of experience, but they must have a fundamental, deep understanding of how the internet and networking work.

Cloud & Virtualization

Productivity & Automation

• Configuration Management: understanding of config file formats (JSON, YAML, INI, etc.). Also, OS Configuration like environmental variables and “PATH” management.

Security-conscious: you think before you act. Least privilege on accounts, handle data carefully, don't leave passwords in plain text.

Candidate Persona & Culture Fit

o You will need to create flowcharts and documentation in English as well, so writing is important.

title: Outreach & Programme Coordinator
description:
Position Overview

Zero Hunger Project is seeking an organized and community-focused Outreach and Programme Coordinator to grow our coalition, strengthen partner relationships, and coordinate programmes addressing hunger, food insecurity, and poverty.

The successful candidate will reach out to community organizations, post secondary institutions, governments, corporates, invite them to join our coalition, and support their ongoing engagement. They will also coordinate programme activities, host regular coalition meetings, and organize learning sessions for partner organizations and the clients and communities they serve.



Key Responsibilities:

Community Outreach and Coalition Development:

- Identify and engage community organizations, food programmes, social service agencies, educational institutions, governments and Corporations, and other potential coalition partners.

- Introduce Zero Hunger Project’s mission, explain the coalition’s purpose and benefits, and invite organizations to participate.

- Follow up with prospective members and coordinate onboarding.

- Maintain regular communication with members to understand their needs, priorities, and opportunities for collaboration.

- Represent Zero Hunger Project at community events, meetings, and networking opportunities.

- Maintain accurate records of contacts, outreach activities, membership, and engagement.



Programme Planning and Coordination:

- Work with the team and coalition partners to identify community needs and develop relevant programmes.

- Prepare programme plans outlining objectives, activities, schedules, responsibilities, budgets, and expected outcomes.

- Coordinate day-to-day delivery of workshops, community initiatives, and partner activities.

- Maintain a shared programme calendar and coordinate staff, volunteers, speakers, and resources.

Track approved programme expenses and provide supporting information to the finance lead.

- Schedule and facilitate regular coalition meetings and programme working groups.

- Prepare agendas, coordinate presentations, and circulate meeting materials.

- Encourage inclusive discussions, knowledge sharing, and collaborative action.

- Record decisions and action items, assign follow-up responsibilities, and track commitments.

- Connect partners with relevant resources, expertise, and opportunities for joint initiatives.



Learning Sessions and Community Participation:

- Identify learning interests and needs among coalition members, clients, and community participants.

- Organize and host workshops, information sessions, and peer-learning activities.

- Recruit speakers and facilitators and coordinate practical, audience-appropriate content.

- Manage registration, invitations, reminders, venues or virtual platforms, and session materials.

- Coordinate accessibility accommodations and language support where needed and available.

- Create a welcoming environment that respects diverse backgrounds and lived experiences.



Communications, Monitoring, and Reporting

- Prepare member updates, programme announcements, invitations, and activity summaries.

- Work with the communications team to share approved programme updates and partner stories.

- Track outreach results, attendance, member participation, programme outputs, and participant feedback.

- Prepare regular reports outlining progress, achievements, challenges, and recommended improvements.

- Maintain organized programme records and handle participant and partner information responsibly.



Required Qualifications

- Education or relevant experience in community development, programme coordination, social services, nonprofit management, communications, or a related field.

- Experience is Sales and Marketing.

- Experience in community outreach, partnership development, or stakeholder engagement.

- Experience coordinating programmes, workshops, events, or community initiatives.

- Strong interpersonal skills and confidence approaching new organizations and building lasting relationships.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to facilitate meetings and engage people with diverse perspectives.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.

- Proficiency with spreadsheets, shared documents,
, and virtual meeting platforms.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively with staff, volunteers, and partners.

- A commitment to addressing hunger and poverty through inclusive community engagement.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting a coalition, community network, or nonprofit programme.

- Familiarity with food security initiatives and community services.

- Experience engaging people with lived experience of food insecurity or poverty.

- Knowledge of accessible event planning and inclusive facilitation.

- Experience tracking budgets, evaluating activities, or preparing programme reports.

- Familiarity with CRM or contact management systems.

- Additional language skills relevant to the communities served.



Expected Outcomes

- A growing coalition with active and sustained member participation.

- Well-organized programmes that respond to community and partner needs.

- Regular, productive coalition meetings with clear follow-through.

- Accessible learning sessions that provide practical value to organizations and participants.

- Accurate records and timely reporting that support continuous programme improvement.



Working Conditions

- The role will involve working various hours including evening or weekend meetings and activities. Specific scheduling will be discussed during recruitment.



How to Apply

- Please submit your résumé and a brief cover letter outlining your outreach and programme coordination experience to

This is more than a traditional Executive Chef role.

We're looking for a seasoned culinary leader who can oversee and strengthen an entire culinary operation — from products and recipes to food quality, food safety, training, systems, and profitability.

You'll diagnose urgent product and quality problems, build the systems and standards needed to fix them, and create a culinary operation that can maintain consistent quality even as the business grows, locations change, and people come and go.



This is a fully remote leadership role. Dedicated on-site Head Chefs handle day-to-day kitchen execution. Your focus is on the culinary standards, systems, processes, and leadership that keep multiple locations and concepts consistent and profitable.





What You'll Own:



Lead and strengthen culinary operations across multiple locations, concepts, and teams

Assess products, menus, recipes, suppliers, and production processes using data, reports, and remote evidence

Diagnose and direct fixes for taste, consistency, quality, and food-safety issues

Work through on-site Head Chefs and culinary leaders to ensure standards are executed consistently

Build controlled recipes, specifications, production standards, and processes with clear tolerances and version control

Standardize culinary systems across restaurants, commissary/central kitchen, bakery, catering, and other food operations as needed

Lead menu engineering — improve, reposition, standardize, or remove underperforming products

Establish food-safety, quality, and traceability systems, including root-cause analysis

Build training, development, and succession systems for culinary teams

Own the culinary drivers of food cost, yield, waste, consistency, and margin

Use technology, data, and AI to improve culinary decision-making, communication, and operational control

Create systems that preserve culinary knowledge and maintain continuity despite team turnover







What We're Looking For:



10+ years of progressive culinary/F&B leadership experience, ideally at Executive Chef, Culinary Director, Corporate Chef, or equivalent level

Significant experience leading multi-location, multi-concept, or complex hospitality/F&B operations

Strong practical culinary background across different cuisines, products, and operating environments

Working knowledge of bakery and pastry operations, including products, recipes, production processes, and quality standards

Proven ability to restore product quality and build repeatable culinary systems — not just cook well

Experience with recipes, specifications, SOPs, production standards, quality control, and training systems

Comfortable leading and directing kitchen execution remotely through on-site culinary leaders

Strong understanding of food cost, yield, waste, portion control, and labor economics

Experience with food safety, quality assurance, and traceability

Strong systems, technology, data, and communication skills

Advanced, practical use of AI and modern digital tools

Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance culinary quality with profitability



Bonus Points:



Experience across multiple cuisines, concepts, brands, or dayparts

Commissary, central kitchen, bakery, catering, or large-scale food production experience

Beverage operations or dining service experience

Experience leading distributed or remote culinary teams

Experience building training and succession pipelines

Experience standardizing culinary operations during growth, restructuring, or expansion



You'll Thrive Here If You...



Believe quality should survive turnover, distance, and growth — not depend on one person's memory

Can lead and influence experienced kitchen teams without being physically present

Bring both deep culinary expertise and strong systems/technology thinking

Balance exacting culinary standards with real commercial judgment

Enjoy diagnosing problems and building practical solutions

Want to build a culinary system that is consistent, scalable, and sustainable — not simply run a kitchen

Paid Time Off (PTO)

Additional Leave

Work from Anywhere / Work from Home

title: B2B Appointment Setter (Outbound Sales)
description:
B2B APPOINTMENT SETTER (OUTBOUND SALES)



Remote in the Philippines

Full-time contractor

US$1,800 to US$2,000/month plus bonuses

80 hours of paid time off a year



I’m Nathan, founder of Dealer Lux. We build websites for independent hot tub, pool and fireplace dealers across North America. I’m looking for someone who can reach a busy dealer, hear what’s going on in their showroom and book a demo worth their time.



Several of our Philippines teammates have been here since 2022. Some now lead departments. The team organizes hangouts, and we sponsor games and prizes.



I’ll teach you the product and we’ll review calls together. I run the demos today. Once you’re consistently bringing in good meetings, you could start running demos too. If we grow the team, you could help lead it.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Check the dealer’s website and HubSpot history for one good reason to call.

• Confirm who’s coming and what they want to see. Give me a short handoff and follow up on missed demos.



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR

You’ve cold-called US business owners or managers and booked B2B meetings. If you’ve sold to dealerships, sold websites or digital marketing, or won over owners in another industry, I’d love to hear about it.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 4 p.m. US Pacific, with an hour for lunch. You’ll need a quiet place to call and reliable internet for the overnight shift.



You’ll earn US$50 when a qualified dealer attends their first demo and US$250 for each website customer you bring in who pays the build fee. We pay the top of the base range for a track record of getting owners to attend.



HOW TO APPLY

Sign in with Google to upload your résumé and tell us about one campaign you worked. Use the Google account where you’d like to hear from me. It takes about five minutes. I’ll start reviewing applications the week of November 30 and reach out to set up 15-minute calls.

Website design experience



Please submit links to your brand identity portfolio in Figma, Behānce, as a PDF, or on a website. We'd love to see your process too: early explorations, rejected directions, and finished brand guides, not just final logos.

Web or software developers

title: Full-Time Appointment Setter (US Business Clients)
description:
About us



We help US small business owners who are struggling with high-cost business debt. Our clients are under real pressure, and we help them find a way out. We're a fast-growing team, and our setters are a big reason why.



The role

You'll call US business owners, find out where they stand, and book qualified appointments for our closing team. This is outbound calling. We give you the leads, the script, the training and the tools. You bring the energy and the consistency.



What you'll do



Make 400+ dials a day using our power dialer

Have real conversations with business owners and qualify them using our process

Book appointments and log everything in our CRM (Close)

Follow up with leads on our set schedule

Hit daily and weekly targets



Schedule

Full-time, 40 hours/week, Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (9:00 PM to 5:00 AM Philippine time)



Pay



$5/hour base

Commission on every appointment that turns into a client

Performance bonuses

Top performers earn well above the base. We pay weekly.



Requirements



Strong spoken English, clear and confident on the phone

Outbound calling or appointment setting experience (sales, collections, lending or finance experience is a plus but not required, since we train you)

Quiet place to work, a headset with a noise-cancelling mic, and stable internet with a backup connection

Comfortable hearing "no" many times a day without losing energy

Available for the full US Eastern shift



How to apply

Applications that don't follow these steps will not be reviewed.



Use the subject line: "Setter - [Your Name] - BLUE"

Attach a voice recording (1-2 minutes) where you:

Introduce yourself and describe your calling experience

Read this out loud: "Hi, this is [your name] calling from Capital Cure. I'm reaching out because we work with business owners who have taken on business funding and are feeling the pressure from daily or weekly payments. Do you have a quick minute?"

Answer: "What do you say when a business owner tells you they're not interested and hangs up?"

title: Customer Service Representative (Remote, Full-Time) — U.S. Pest Control
description:
Customer Service Representative — Remote, Full-Time

Prime Pest & Lawn is a growing residential pest control and lawn care company serving homeowners in several U.S. states. We are hiring remote Customer Service Representatives to join our office team as the first voice our customers hear.

This is a long-term role with a published career path. We are not looking for someone to answer and transfer. We are looking for people who like talking to customers, can solve the problem on the call, and want to grow with one company.



What You Will Do

Answer inbound calls — Scheduling, billing questions, service questions, reservices and bookings for all of our branches.

Work our
 and text inbox — Clear, friendly, accurate replies, worked to empty every shift.

Help customers who want to cancel — Understand why, and make a genuine effort to keep them.

Keep perfect records — Log every conversation in our customer system the same day.

Make outbound calls — Appointment confirmations and follow-up lists when the phones are quiet.



What We Require

Clear, easily understood spoken and written English

At least one year of live phone customer service experience

Genuine warmth and patience with homeowners who are frustrated or worried

A quiet place to work, a computer, a noise-cancelling headset and wired internet

A backup plan for power and internet outages

Availability Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Mountain Time (11:00 PM to 8:00 AM Philippine time while the U.S. is on standard time)

This must be your only job. We need your best hours, not a second shift.

What Will Move You To The Top Of The List

FieldRoutes experience — This is the system we run on.

Pest control or lawn care experience — You will already understand what customers are calling about.

Cancellation saves or retention work — You know how to keep a customer without arguing with them.



What We Offer

Pay — $6.00 to $8.00 USD per hour, based on experience, paid twice a month and always on time.

13th month pay — Every December, prorated for months worked.

Paid training — Structured, hands-on, and live training with our team from your first day.

A real career path — Customer Service Representative, then Branch Specialist, then Team Lead, with a higher pay band at each step.

A team, not a task list — You will join our meetings, know our branch managers by name, and be treated as part of Prime.

How To Apply — Please Read Carefully

We do not review written applications on their own. To be considered, you must do both of the following.

Put the words "Prime Customer Care" in the subject line of your application.

Record yourself answering the four questions below, as a voice recording or a video, and include the link in your application.



The Four Questions

Introduce yourself and tell us about your experience handling customer phone calls. Where will you work from, and what is your backup if your power or internet goes out?

Tell us about a time a customer was upset with you. What did you say, and how did it end?

Have you used FieldRoutes or any other customer or scheduling software? What did you do in it?

A customer calls to cancel their pest control because they are still seeing bugs. In your own words, how would you respond? Just do your best. We are listening to how you talk to people, not checking whether you know our programs.

Applications without a recording or without the subject line will not be reviewed. Thank you for taking the time to apply.

title: Property Lead Generation & Viewing Booker (Part-Time, UK Property)
description:
Property Lead Generation & Viewing Booker (Part-Time, UK Property)



We’re a London-based letting business with 700+ properties to fill: rooms, studios, 1-beds, 2-beds, 3-beds and larger. Most are in London, with others in cities across the UK. We need a creative, self-driven lead generator to bring in qualified tenants and book them in for viewings.



What you’ll do



Find and attract tenants through non-traditional channels. Rightmove, Zoopla, OpenRent and SpareRoom are already covered by other agents, so we want fresh sources and creative approaches.

Qualify leads before booking (budget, move-in date, requirements, suitability).

Book as many qualified viewings as possible across our available properties.

Hit a monthly viewing target (agreed at the start).

Set up and use AI and automation so every tenant inquiry gets a reply within 5 minutes, even when you’re offline.



What we’re looking for



Proven experience in property, tenant finding, or lead generation (qualified leads, not just volume).

A creative thinker who can find tenants where other agents aren’t looking.

Strong with AI tools and automation (chatbots, auto-responders, CRM or workflow tools such as Zapier or Make).

Excellent written English and a professional, friendly communication style.

Reliable, organised and results-driven.



Hours



Part-time, around 20 hours per week.

Must be available between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM UK time (London). Some flexibility is possible for highly experienced candidates.



Pay



Starting at $275 per month, with room to grow.

Fixed, uncapped commission: $200 per room let and $250 per apartment let.

Paid 1-month trial, then a permanent position based on performance.



Support

I’ll help you prioritise the properties that are easiest and most profitable to let, based on my experience in the market, so you can focus your effort where it counts.



To apply, please include:



Your relevant experience in property, tenant finding or lead generation

Examples of creative methods you’ve used to generate leads

The AI or automation tools you’ve worked with

Your availability for the 10 AM to 5 PM UK window

Your expected pay



Start your application with the word “VIEWINGS” AND use 10 AP so I know you’ve read the full post.
